"""Pure RAW BELOW BODY ACF recovery proof; no financial or data-provider capabilities."""

from copy import deepcopy
import ast
from hashlib import sha256
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import traceback
import types
from unittest.mock import patch

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from strategy_runtime import ParameterSet, StrategyCandidate, StrategyRuntime, implementation_sha256
from strategy_evaluator import (
    AssessmentCandidate,
    ParameterCoordinate,
    ParameterCoordinateKind,
    ParameterDesignRequest,
    ParameterPerturbationProtocol,
    ParameterSpace,
    build_parameter_perturbation_design,
)

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = next(p for p in HERE.parents if (p / "research/S013/experiments").is_dir())
SOURCE = HERE / "strategy_runtime"
PARENTS = ("range_reversion", "adaptive_range", "confirmed_range", "reentry_confirmed_range")
FILES = [
    "strategies/" + p + ".py" for p in (*PARENTS, "bear_time_below_dual_recovery_range", "__init__")
]


def load(source, name, file):
    package = types.ModuleType(name)
    package.__path__ = [str(source / "strategies")]
    sys.modules[name] = package
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
        name + "." + file, source / "strategies" / (file + ".py")
    )
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[spec.name] = module
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


def main():
    checks = []

    def check(name, ok=True):
        assert ok, name
        checks.append(name)

    def refuse(name, call):
        try:
            call()
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            checks.append(name)
        else:
            raise AssertionError("Expected rejection: " + name)

    oldsource = ROOT / "research/S013/experiments/EX012_20261011/src/strategy_runtime"
    new = load(SOURCE, "_ex056_new", "bear_time_below_dual_recovery_range")
    prior55 = load(
        ROOT / ".tmp/ex055-raw-recovery-prototype/strategy_runtime",
        "_ex056_prior55",
        "bear_time_below_recovery_range",
    )
    old = load(oldsource, "_ex056_old", "reentry_confirmed_range")
    plan = json.loads(
        (ROOT / "research/S013/experiments/EX012_20261011/protocols/plan.json").read_text("utf-8")
    )
    center = deepcopy(
        next(
            c["payload"]["parameters"]
            for c in plan["configurations"]
            if c["candidate_id"] == "C2132"
        )
    )
    p = {**deepcopy(center), "mechanism": "RAW_BEAR_TIME_BELOW_BODY_CLOSE_ACF_RECOVERY"}
    prior_tree = ast.parse(
        (
            ROOT
            / ".tmp/ex055-raw-recovery-prototype/strategy_runtime/strategies/bear_time_below_recovery_range.py"
        ).read_text("utf-8")
    )
    new_tree = ast.parse(
        (SOURCE / "strategies/bear_time_below_dual_recovery_range.py").read_text("utf-8")
    )

    def normalized(tree):
        tree = deepcopy(tree)
        tree.body = tree.body[1:]
        for node in ast.walk(tree):
            if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef):
                node.name = node.name.replace("DualRecovery", "Recovery")
            if isinstance(node, ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.value, str):
                node.value = node.value.replace("BODY_CLOSE_ACF", "BODY_ACF").replace(
                    "body and close ACF recovery", "body ACF recovery"
                )
            if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) and any(
                isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id == "direction" for target in node.targets
            ):
                node.value = ast.parse("(signal_close > signal_open).to_numpy()", mode="eval").body
        return ast.dump(tree, include_attributes=False)

    check(
        "whole runtime AST55 exact except enum class direction and explanatory docstring",
        normalized(prior_tree) == normalized(new_tree),
    )

    def branch_body(tree, name):
        node = next(
            n
            for n in ast.walk(tree)
            if isinstance(n, ast.If) and isinstance(n.test, ast.Name) and n.test.id == name
        )
        return ast.dump(ast.Module(body=node.body, type_ignores=[]), include_attributes=False)

    check(
        "held state/age/anchor/peak and all final exit priority AST55 exact",
        branch_body(prior_tree, "holding") == branch_body(new_tree, "holding"),
    )
    check(
        "successful entry anchor and context consumption AST55 exact",
        branch_body(prior_tree, "passed") == branch_body(new_tree, "passed"),
    )
    check(
        "no extra direction rejection source",
        not any(
            isinstance(n, ast.Constant) and n.value == "entry_direction_rejected"
            for n in ast.walk(new_tree)
        ),
    )
    native = new.BearTimeBelowDualRecoveryRange(ParameterSet(p))
    parent = old.ReentryConfirmedRange(ParameterSet(center))
    check("numeric center and parent warmup180 exact", native._warmup == parent._warmup == 180)
    for file in PARENTS:
        check(
            "parent byte exact " + file,
            (SOURCE / "strategies" / (file + ".py")).read_bytes()
            == (oldsource / "strategies" / (file + ".py")).read_bytes(),
        )
    payload = {
        "parameters": p,
        "runtime": {
            "contract_version": 1,
            "module": "strategy_runtime.strategies.bear_time_below_dual_recovery_range",
            "qualname": "BearTimeBelowDualRecoveryRange",
            "source_files": FILES,
            "source_sha256": implementation_sha256(FILES, source_root=SOURCE),
        },
    }
    bound = StrategyRuntime().describe(StrategyCandidate("S013", "C8280", payload, SOURCE))
    check(
        "public authenticated prospective describe only",
        bound.parameters.sha256 == ParameterSet(p).sha256,
    )
    rng = np.random.default_rng(13)
    dates = pd.bdate_range("2018-01-01", periods=740)
    prices = 10 * np.exp(np.cumsum(rng.normal(0.0001, 0.02, len(dates))))
    bars = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "Date": dates,
            "Close": prices,
            "Open": prices * 0.999,
            "High": prices * 1.01,
            "Low": prices * 0.99,
            "Volume": np.exp(rng.normal(14, 0.3, len(dates))),
            "Amount": np.exp(rng.normal(18, 0.3, len(dates))),
        }
    )
    sessions = dates[400:]
    history = native.calculate_history({"daily": bars}, sessions)
    baseline = parent.calculate_history({"daily": bars}, sessions)
    added = {
        "last_exit_reason",
        "last_exit_route",
        "last_exit_category",
        "entry_direction_gate_applies",
        "entry_direction_up",
        "previous_signal_close",
        "entry_signal_close",
        "entry_signal_open",
        "bear_acf_raw",
        "entry_acf_value",
        "entry_acf_pass",
        "entry_acf_recovery_applies",
        "entry_eligible",
    }
    check(
        "only declared schema additions no mean or previous regime",
        set(history) - set(baseline) == added and not set(baseline) - set(history),
    )
    static = [
        "acf1",
        "close",
        "momentum20",
        "regime",
        "regime_momentum",
        "bull_range_position",
        "bear_range_position",
        "confirmation_score",
        "confirmation_acf",
        "confirmation_turnover",
        "confirmation_volume",
        "confirmation_pass",
    ]
    pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(history[static], baseline[static], check_exact=True)
    check("all raw features original score and routing exact")
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(
        history.entry_direction_up,
        (bars.Close.gt(bars.Open) & bars.Close.gt(bars.Close.shift(1))).iloc[400:],
    )
    check("first selected previousClose from full history")
    pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(
        native.calculate_history({"daily": bars.iloc[:560]}, dates[400:560]),
        history.iloc[:160],
        check_exact=True,
    )
    changed = bars.copy()
    changed.loc[560:, ["Open", "Close", "High", "Low", "Volume", "Amount"]] *= 1.7
    pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(
        native.calculate_history({"daily": changed}, sessions).iloc[:160],
        history.iloc[:160],
        check_exact=True,
    )
    check("all schema exact prefix and future OHLCVA causality")
    opening_only = bars.copy()
    opening_only.loc[560:, "Open"] *= 1.4
    pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(

def load(source, name, file):
    package = types.ModuleType(name)
    package.__path__ = [str(source / "strategies")]
    sys.modules[name] = package
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
        name + "." + file, source / "strategies" / (file + ".py")
    )
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[spec.name] = module
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module

        tree = deepcopy(tree)
        tree.body = tree.body[1:]
        for node in ast.walk(tree):
            if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef):
                node.name = node.name.replace("DualRecovery", "Recovery")
            if isinstance(node, ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.value, str):
                node.value = node.value.replace("BODY_CLOSE_ACF", "BODY_ACF").replace(
                    "body and close ACF recovery", "body ACF recovery"
                )
            if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) and any(
                isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id == "direction" for target in node.targets
            ):
                node.value = ast.parse("(signal_close > signal_open).to_numpy()", mode="eval").body
        return ast.dump(tree, include_attributes=False)

"""S013 causal dual-route range strategy; routing uses only known daily closes."""

from collections.abc import Mapping
from dataclasses import replace
import math

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from strategy_runtime import InputContract, ParameterSet

from .range_reversion import RangeReversion, components


class AdaptiveRange(RangeReversion):
    def __init__(self, parameters):
        p = parameters.values
        if set(p) != {"bull", "bear", "regime_window", "regime_threshold", "exit_on_regime_change"}:
            raise ValueError("exact adaptive parameter contract required")
        if type(p["regime_window"]) is not int or not 5 <= p["regime_window"] <= 60:
            raise ValueError("regime_window must be 5..60 sessions")
        if (
            type(p["regime_threshold"]) is not float
            or not math.isfinite(p["regime_threshold"])
            or not -0.2 <= p["regime_threshold"] <= 0.2
        ):
            raise ValueError("regime_threshold must be a finite float in [-.2,.2]")
        if type(p["exit_on_regime_change"]) is not bool:
            raise ValueError("exit_on_regime_change must be bool")
        for key in ("bull", "bear"):
            if not isinstance(p[key], Mapping):
                raise ValueError(key + " must contain complete range parameters")
        self._routes = {key: RangeReversion(ParameterSet(p[key])) for key in ("bull", "bear")}
        if p["bull"]["limit_premium"] != p["bear"]["limit_premium"]:
            raise ValueError("route limit_premium must be identical")
        self._parameters = parameters
        self._warmup = max(
            p["bull"]["range_window"], p["bear"]["range_window"], p["regime_window"] + 1, 21
        )

    @property
    def definition(self):
        base = self._routes["bull"].definition
        requirements = tuple(
            replace(item, lookback_sessions=self._warmup) if item.name == "daily" else item
            for item in base.inputs.requirements
        )
        return replace(base, parameters=self._parameters, inputs=InputContract(requirements))

    def calendar_request(self, window):
        return super().calendar_request(window)

    def calculate_history(self, inputs, sessions):
        p = self._parameters.values
        route_features = {
            key: components(inputs["daily"], p[key]["range_window"]).reindex(sessions)
            for key in ("bull", "bear")
        }
        for feature in route_features.values():
            if not np.isfinite(feature.to_numpy()).all():
                raise ValueError("required causal route features missing")
        bars = inputs["daily"].copy()
        bars.index = pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(bars.Date)).normalize()
        close = bars.Close.astype(float)
        regime_momentum = (close / close.shift(p["regime_window"]) - 1).reindex(sessions)
        if not np.isfinite(regime_momentum.to_numpy()).all():
            raise ValueError("required causal regime features missing")
        regimes = np.where(regime_momentum.to_numpy() >= p["regime_threshold"], "bull", "bear")
        holding = False
        active_route = None
        age = cooldown = 0
        anchor = peak = 0.0
        targets, reasons, positions = [], [], []
        for i, regime in enumerate(regimes):
            route = active_route if holding else regime
            rp = p[route]
            row = route_features[route].iloc[i]
            positions.append(row.range_position)
            reason = "flat"
            if holding:
                age += 1
                peak = max(peak, row.close)
                loss = rp["stop_loss"] is not None and row.close / anchor - 1 <= -rp["stop_loss"]
                trail = (
                    rp["trailing_stop"] is not None and row.close / peak - 1 <= -rp["trailing_stop"]
                )
                changed = p["exit_on_regime_change"] and regime != active_route
                if (
                    loss
                    or trail
                    or row.range_position >= rp["exit"]
                    or age >= rp["max_hold"]
                    or changed
                ):
                    holding = False
                    cooldown = rp["cooldown"]
                    reason = (
                        "loss"
                        if loss
                        else "trailing"
                        if trail
                        else "range"
                        if row.range_position >= rp["exit"]
                        else "time"
                        if age >= rp["max_hold"]
                        else "regime"
                    )
                    active_route = None
                else:
                    reason = "hold"
            elif cooldown:
                cooldown -= 1
                reason = "cooldown"
            elif (
                row.range_position <= rp["entry"]
                and (rp["acf_min"] is None or row.acf1 >= rp["acf_min"])
                and (rp["momentum_min"] is None or row.momentum20 >= rp["momentum_min"])
            ):
                holding = True
                active_route = regime
                age = 0
                anchor = peak = row.close
                reason = "entry"
            targets.append(float(holding))
            reasons.append(reason)
        return route_features["bull"].assign(
            range_position=positions,
            target_position=targets,
            signal_reason=reasons,
            regime=regimes,
            regime_momentum=regime_momentum,
            bull_range_position=route_features["bull"].range_position,
            bear_range_position=route_features["bear"].range_position,
        )

"""Original raw ACF with a local BODY-up and CLOSE-up recovery exception after BELOW bear TIME exits."""

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from strategy_runtime import ParameterSet
from .reentry_confirmed_range import ReentryConfirmedRange
from .confirmed_range import PROFILES, confirmation_features
from .range_reversion import components


class BearTimeBelowDualRecoveryRange(ReentryConfirmedRange):
    def __init__(self, parameters):
        p = parameters.values
        if p.get("mechanism") != "RAW_BEAR_TIME_BELOW_BODY_CLOSE_ACF_RECOVERY":
            raise ValueError(
                "explicit raw bear TIME BELOW body and close ACF recovery mechanism required"
            )
        if p.get("confirmation", {}).get("enabled") is not True:
            raise ValueError("original buy confirmation must remain enabled")
        super().__init__(
            ParameterSet({key: value for key, value in p.items() if key != "mechanism"})
        )
        self._parameters = parameters

    def calculate_history(self, inputs, sessions):
        p = self._parameters.values
        c, settings = p["confirmation"], p["context"]
        daily = inputs["daily"]
        if not {"Date", "Open", "Close"}.issubset(daily.columns):
            raise ValueError("complete signal Date/Open/Close required")
        prices = daily.loc[:, ["Open", "Close"]].to_numpy(dtype=float)
        if not np.isfinite(prices).all() or (prices <= 0).any():
            raise ValueError("signal Open/Close must be finite and positive")
        all_features = {
            key: components(inputs["daily"], p[key]["range_window"]) for key in ("bull", "bear")
        }
        raw_bear_acf = all_features["bear"].acf1
        features = {key: frame.reindex(sessions) for key, frame in all_features.items()}
        if not all(np.isfinite(frame.to_numpy()).all() for frame in features.values()):
            raise ValueError("required causal route features missing")
        score_bars = inputs["daily"].copy()
        if settings["volume_basis"] == "RAW":
            raw = inputs["execution"].copy()
            raw.index = pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(raw.Date)).normalize()
            score_bars.index = pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(score_bars.Date)).normalize()
            if (
                not raw.index.is_unique
                or not raw.index.is_monotonic_increasing
                or not raw.index.isin(score_bars.index).all()
            ):
                raise ValueError(
                    "raw volume dates must be unique, ordered and share the adjusted calendar"
                )
            adjusted = score_bars.loc[raw.index]
            reconstructed = adjusted.Volume * adjusted.Close / raw.Close
            if not np.allclose(
                reconstructed.to_numpy(), raw.Volume.to_numpy(), rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-6
            ):
                raise ValueError("per-date raw/HFQ volume conversion differs")
            if not np.allclose(
                adjusted.Amount.to_numpy(), raw.Amount.to_numpy(), rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-6
            ):
                raise ValueError("amount must be invariant across price-unit conversion")
            score_bars = adjusted.assign(Volume=raw.Volume)
        _, normalized = confirmation_features(score_bars, all_features["bull"].acf1, c["lookback"])
        normalized = normalized.reindex(sessions)
        if not np.isfinite(normalized.to_numpy()).all():
            raise ValueError("complete causal confirmation history missing")
        score = (
            0.5 * normalized.acf + 0.25 * normalized.turnover + 0.25 * normalized.volume
            if settings["weighting"] == "EQUAL_BLOCKS"
            else normalized.loc[:, list(PROFILES[c["profile"]])].mean(axis=1)
        ) * c["orientation"]
        bars = inputs["daily"].copy()
        bars.index = pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(bars.Date)).normalize()
        close = bars.Close.astype(float)
        signal_close = close.reindex(sessions)
        signal_open = bars.Open.astype(float).reindex(sessions)
        previous_close = close.shift(1).reindex(sessions)
        if not np.isfinite(np.column_stack((signal_close, signal_open, previous_close))).all():
            raise ValueError("complete current and previous signal prices required")
        direction = ((signal_close > signal_open) & (signal_close > previous_close)).to_numpy()
        all_momentum = close / close.shift(p["regime_window"]) - 1
        momentum = all_momentum.reindex(sessions)
        if not np.isfinite(momentum.to_numpy()).all():
            raise ValueError("required causal regime features missing")
        regimes = np.where(momentum.to_numpy() >= p["regime_threshold"], "bull", "bear")
        holding = False
        active_route = None
        last_exit_reason = None
        last_exit_route = None
        last_exit_category = None
        age = 0
        anchor = peak = 0.0
        targets, reasons, positions, opportunities, passes, contexts = [], [], [], [], [], []
        entry_acf_values, entry_acf_passes, direction_gate_applies = [], [], []
        recovery_flags, eligibility_flags = [], []
        previous_exit_reasons, previous_exit_routes, previous_exit_categories = [], [], []
        for i, regime in enumerate(regimes):
            previous_exit_reasons.append(last_exit_reason)
            previous_exit_routes.append(last_exit_route)
            previous_exit_categories.append(last_exit_category)
            route = active_route if holding else regime
            rp = p[route]
            row = features[route].iloc[i]
            positions.append(row.range_position)
            entry_acf = row.acf1
            acf_pass = rp["acf_min"] is None or entry_acf >= rp["acf_min"]
            entry_acf_values.append(entry_acf)
            entry_acf_passes.append(acf_pass)
            range_pass = row.range_position <= rp["entry"]
            momentum_pass = rp["momentum_min"] is None or row.momentum20 >= rp["momentum_min"]
            recovery_context = (
                not holding
                and regime == "bear"
                and last_exit_reason == "time"
                and last_exit_route == "bear"
                and last_exit_category == "BELOW"
                and direction[i]
            )
            recovered = range_pass and momentum_pass and not acf_pass and recovery_context
            eligible = range_pass and momentum_pass and (acf_pass or recovery_context)
            recovery_flags.append(bool(recovered))
            eligibility_flags.append(bool(eligible))
            applies = c["scope"] in ("both", regime) and (
                settings["entry_gate"] == "all" or last_exit_reason == "regime"
            )
            opportunity = not holding and eligible
            # BODY-and-CLOSE is an eligibility exception, never an extra veto of original entries.
            direction_gate_applies.append(False)
            passed = not applies or score.iloc[i] >= c["threshold"]
            opportunities.append(opportunity)
            passes.append(passed)
            contexts.append(last_exit_reason or "initial")
            reason = "flat"
            if holding:
                age += 1
                peak = max(peak, row.close)
                loss = rp["stop_loss"] is not None and row.close / anchor - 1 <= -rp["stop_loss"]
                trail = (
                    rp["trailing_stop"] is not None and row.close / peak - 1 <= -rp["trailing_stop"]
                )
                changed = p["exit_on_regime_change"] and regime != active_route
                if (
                    loss
                    or trail
                    or row.range_position >= rp["exit"]
                    or age >= rp["max_hold"]
                    or changed
                ):
                    holding = False
                    reason = (
                        "loss"
                        if loss
                        else "trailing"
                        if trail
                        else "range"
                        if row.range_position >= rp["exit"]
                        else "time"
                        if age >= rp["max_hold"]
                        else "regime"
                    )
                    last_exit_reason = reason
                    last_exit_route = active_route
                    # Classify only the final bear TIME exit against this signal episode's anchor.
                    last_exit_category = (
                        (
                            "BELOW"
                            if row.close < anchor
                            else "ABOVE"
                            if row.close > anchor
                            else "EQUAL"
                        )
                        if reason == "time" and active_route == "bear"
                        else None
                    )

import math

import pandas as pd

from .adaptive_range import AdaptiveRange
from .range_reversion import components


PROFILES = {
    "acf": ("acf",),
    "turnover": ("turnover",),
    "volume": ("volume",),
    "acf_turnover": ("acf", "turnover"),
    "acf_volume": ("acf", "volume"),
    "turnover_volume": ("turnover", "volume"),
    "all": ("acf", "turnover", "volume"),
}


def causal_rank(values, window):
    """S007-v1 midrank formula; complete trailing window, centered on zero."""

    def last(items):
        current = items[-1]
        return float(
            (np.count_nonzero(items < current) + 0.5 * np.count_nonzero(items == current))
            / len(items)
            - 0.5
        )

    return values.rolling(window, min_periods=window).apply(last, raw=True)


def confirmation_features(bars, acf, window):
    frame = bars.copy()
    frame.index = pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(frame.Date)).normalize()
    volume, amount = frame.Volume.astype(float), frame.Amount.astype(float)
    if (
        not np.isfinite(volume).all()
        or not np.isfinite(amount).all()
        or (volume <= 0).any()
        or (amount <= 0).any()
    ):
        raise ValueError("confirmation requires finite positive volume and amount")
    raw = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "acf": acf,
            "turnover": amount / amount.rolling(20).mean(),
            "volume": np.log(volume).diff().rolling(20).mean(),
        },
        index=frame.index,
    )
    return raw, raw.apply(lambda values: causal_rank(values, window))

import math

class AdaptiveRange(RangeReversion):
    def __init__(self, parameters):
        p = parameters.values

                      'exit_on_regime_change'}:

    def definition(self):

        )

                       inputs=InputContract(requirements))

    def calendar_request(self, window):
        return super().calendar_request(window)

        p = self._parameters.values
        route_features = {
            key: components(inputs['daily'], p[key]['range_window']).reindex(sessions)
            for key in ('bull', 'bear')
        }
        for feature in route_features.values():
            if not np.isfinite(feature.to_numpy()).all():
                raise ValueError('required causal route features missing')
        bars = inputs['daily'].copy()
        bars.index = pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(bars.Date)).normalize()
        close = bars.Close.astype(float)
        regime_momentum = (close / close.shift(p['regime_window']) - 1).reindex(sessions)
        if not np.isfinite(regime_momentum.to_numpy()).all():
            raise ValueError('required causal regime features missing')
        regimes = np.where(regime_momentum.to_numpy() >= p['regime_threshold'],
                           'bull', 'bear')
        holding = False
        active_route = None
        age = cooldown = 0
        anchor = peak = 0.0
        targets, reasons, positions = [], [], []
        for i, regime in enumerate(regimes):
            route = active_route if holding else regime
            rp = p[route]
            row = route_features[route].iloc[i]
            positions.append(row.range_position)
            reason = 'flat'
            if holding:
                age += 1
                peak = max(peak, row.close)
                loss = rp['stop_loss'] is not None and row.close / anchor - 1 <= -rp['stop_loss']
                trail = rp['trailing_stop'] is not None and row.close / peak - 1 <= -rp['trailing_stop']
                changed = p['exit_on_regime_change'] and regime != active_route
                if loss or trail or row.range_position >= rp['exit'] or age >= rp['max_hold'] or changed:

                    cooldown = rp['cooldown']
                    reason = ('loss' if loss else 'trailing' if trail else

                              'time' if age >= rp['max_hold'] else 'regime')
                    active_route = None
                else:
                    reason = 'hold'
            elif cooldown:
                cooldown -= 1

            elif (row.range_position <= rp['entry']

                  and (rp['momentum_min'] is None or row.momentum20 >= rp['momentum_min'])):
                holding = True
                active_route = regime

        if not np.isfinite(np.column_stack((signal_close, signal_open, previous_close))).all():
            raise ValueError("complete current and previous signal prices required")
        direction = ((signal_close > signal_open) & (signal_close > previous_close)).to_numpy()
        all_momentum = close / close.shift(p["regime_window"]) - 1
        momentum = all_momentum.reindex(sessions)
        if not np.isfinite(momentum.to_numpy()).all():
            raise ValueError("required causal regime features missing")
        regimes = np.where(momentum.to_numpy() >= p["regime_threshold"], "bull", "bear")
        holding = False
        active_route = None
        last_exit_reason = None
        last_exit_route = None
        last_exit_category = None
        age = 0
        anchor = peak = 0.0
        targets, reasons, positions, opportunities, passes, contexts = [], [], [], [], [], []
        entry_acf_values, entry_acf_passes, direction_gate_applies = [], [], []
        recovery_flags, eligibility_flags = [], []
        previous_exit_reasons, previous_exit_routes, previous_exit_categories = [], [], []
        for i, regime in enumerate(regimes):
            previous_exit_reasons.append(last_exit_reason)
            previous_exit_routes.append(last_exit_route)
            previous_exit_categories.append(last_exit_category)
            route = active_route if holding else regime
            rp = p[route]
            row = features[route].iloc[i]
            positions.append(row.range_position)
            entry_acf = row.acf1
            acf_pass = rp["acf_min"] is None or entry_acf >= rp["acf_min"]
            entry_acf_values.append(entry_acf)
            entry_acf_passes.append(acf_pass)
            range_pass = row.range_position <= rp["entry"]
            momentum_pass = rp["momentum_min"] is None or row.momentum20 >= rp["momentum_min"]
            recovery_context = (
                not holding
                and regime == "bear"
                and last_exit_reason == "time"
                and last_exit_route == "bear"
                and last_exit_category == "BELOW"
                and direction[i]
            )
            recovered = range_pass and momentum_pass and not acf_pass and recovery_context
            eligible = range_pass and momentum_pass and (acf_pass or recovery_context)
            recovery_flags.append(bool(recovered))
            eligibility_flags.append(bool(eligible))
            applies = c["scope"] in ("both", regime) and (
                settings["entry_gate"] == "all" or last_exit_reason == "regime"
            )
            opportunity = not holding and eligible
            # BODY-and-CLOSE is an eligibility exception, never an extra veto of original entries.
            direction_gate_applies.append(False)
            passed = not applies or score.iloc[i] >= c["threshold"]
            opportunities.append(opportunity)
            passes.append(passed)
            contexts.append(last_exit_reason or "initial")
            reason = "flat"
            if holding:
                age += 1
                peak = max(peak, row.close)
                loss = rp["stop_loss"] is not None and row.close / anchor - 1 <= -rp["stop_loss"]
                trail = (
                    rp["trailing_stop"] is not None and row.close / peak - 1 <= -rp["trailing_stop"]
                )
                changed = p["exit_on_regime_change"] and regime != active_route
                if (
                    loss
                    or trail
                    or row.range_position >= rp["exit"]
                    or age >= rp["max_hold"]
                    or changed
                ):
                    holding = False
                    reason = (
                        "loss"
                        if loss
                        else "trailing"
                        if trail
                        else "range"
                        if row.range_position >= rp["exit"]
                        else "time"
                        if age >= rp["max_hold"]
                        else "regime"
                    )
                    last_exit_reason = reason
                    last_exit_route = active_route
                    # Classify only the final bear TIME exit against this signal episode's anchor.
                    last_exit_category = (
                        (
                            "BELOW"
                            if row.close < anchor
                            else "ABOVE"
                            if row.close > anchor
                            else "EQUAL"
                        )
                        if reason == "time" and active_route == "bear"
                        else None
                    )
                    active_route = None
                else:
                    reason = "hold"
            elif eligible:
                if passed:
                    holding = True
                    active_route = regime
                    age = 0
                    anchor = peak = row.close
                    last_exit_reason = None
                    last_exit_route = None
                    last_exit_category = None
                    reason = "entry"
                else:
                    reason = "confirmation_rejected"
            targets.append(float(holding))
            reasons.append(reason)
        history = features["bull"].assign(
            range_position=positions,
            target_position=targets,
            signal_reason=reasons,
            regime=regimes,
            regime_momentum=momentum,
            entry_direction_gate_applies=direction_gate_applies,
            entry_direction_up=direction,
            previous_signal_close=previous_close,
            entry_signal_close=signal_close,
            entry_signal_open=signal_open,
            bull_range_position=features["bull"].range_position,
            bear_range_position=features["bear"].range_position,
            confirmation_score=score,
            confirmation_acf=normalized.acf,
            confirmation_turnover=normalized.turnover,
            confirmation_volume=normalized.volume,
            confirmation_opportunity=opportunities,
            confirmation_pass=passes,
            confirmation_exit_context=contexts,
            last_exit_reason=pd.Series(previous_exit_reasons, index=sessions, dtype=object),
            last_exit_route=pd.Series(previous_exit_routes, index=sessions, dtype=object),
            last_exit_category=pd.Series(previous_exit_categories, index=sessions, dtype=object),
            bear_acf_raw=raw_bear_acf.reindex(sessions),
            entry_acf_value=entry_acf_values,
            entry_acf_pass=entry_acf_passes,
            entry_acf_recovery_applies=recovery_flags,
            entry_eligible=eligibility_flags,
        )
        return history

"""S013 range opportunity with a causal information-only buy confirmation gate."""
from collections.abc import Mapping
from dataclasses import replace
import math

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from strategy_runtime import InputContract, ParameterSet

from .adaptive_range import AdaptiveRange
from .range_reversion import components


PROFILES = {
    'acf': ('acf',), 'turnover': ('turnover',), 'volume': ('volume',),
    'acf_turnover': ('acf', 'turnover'), 'acf_volume': ('acf', 'volume'),
    'turnover_volume': ('turnover', 'volume'), 'all': ('acf', 'turnover', 'volume'),
}


def causal_rank(values, window):
    """S007-v1 midrank formula; complete trailing window, centered on zero."""
    def last(items):
        current = items[-1]
        return float((np.count_nonzero(items < current)
                      + .5 * np.count_nonzero(items == current)) / len(items) - .5)
    return values.rolling(window, min_periods=window).apply(last, raw=True)


def confirmation_features(bars, acf, window):
    frame = bars.copy()
    frame.index = pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(frame.Date)).normalize()
    volume, amount = frame.Volume.astype(float), frame.Amount.astype(float)
    if not np.isfinite(volume).all() or not np.isfinite(amount).all() or (volume <= 0).any() or (amount <= 0).any():
        raise ValueError('confirmation requires finite positive volume and amount')
    raw = pd.DataFrame({'acf': acf, 'turnover': amount / amount.rolling(20).mean(),
                        'volume': np.log(volume).diff().rolling(20).mean()}, index=frame.index)
    return raw, raw.apply(lambda values: causal_rank(values, window))


class ConfirmedRange(AdaptiveRange):
    def __init__(self, parameters):
        p = parameters.values
        if set(p) != {'bull', 'bear', 'regime_window', 'regime_threshold',
                      'exit_on_regime_change', 'confirmation'}:
            raise ValueError('exact confirmed-range parameter contract required')
        c = p['confirmation']
        if not isinstance(c, Mapping) or set(c) != {'enabled', 'profile', 'threshold', 'orientation', 'scope', 'lookback'}:
            raise ValueError('complete confirmation contract required')
        if type(c['enabled']) is not bool or c['profile'] not in PROFILES or c['scope'] not in ('both', 'bull', 'bear'):
            raise ValueError('invalid confirmation mode, profile or route scope')
        if type(c['lookback']) is not int or not 40 <= c['lookback'] <= 120:
            raise ValueError('normalization lookback must be 40..120 sessions')
        if type(c['orientation']) is not int or c['orientation'] not in (-1, 1):
            raise ValueError('confirmation orientation must be +1 or -1')
        if type(c['threshold']) is not float or not math.isfinite(c['threshold']) or not -.5 <= c['threshold'] <= .5:
            raise ValueError('confirmation threshold must be a finite float in [-.5,.5]')
        if any(p[key]['cooldown'] != 0 for key in ('bull', 'bear')):
            raise ValueError('fixed cooldown is excluded from this research')
        super().__init__(ParameterSet({k: v for k, v in p.items() if k != 'confirmation'}))
        self._parameters = parameters
        self._warmup = max(self._warmup, c['lookback'] + 20)

    @property
    def definition(self):
        base = self._routes['bull'].definition
        requirements = tuple(replace(item, lookback_sessions=self._warmup)
                             if item.name == 'daily' else item for item in base.inputs.requirements)
        return replace(base, parameters=self._parameters, inputs=InputContract(requirements))

    def calculate_history(self, inputs, sessions):
        p = self._parameters.values
        c = p['confirmation']
        if not c['enabled']:
            return super().calculate_history(inputs, sessions)
        all_features = {key: components(inputs['daily'], p[key]['range_window']) for key in ('bull', 'bear')}
        features = {key: frame.reindex(sessions) for key, frame in all_features.items()}
        if not all(np.isfinite(frame.to_numpy()).all() for frame in features.values()):
            raise ValueError('required causal route features missing')
        _, normalized = confirmation_features(inputs['daily'], all_features['bull'].acf1, c['lookback'])
        normalized = normalized.reindex(sessions)
        if not np.isfinite(normalized.to_numpy()).all():
            raise ValueError('complete causal confirmation history missing')
        score = normalized.loc[:, list(PROFILES[c['profile']])].mean(axis=1) * c['orientation']
        bars = inputs['daily'].copy()
        bars.index = pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(bars.Date)).normalize()
        close = bars.Close.astype(float)
        momentum = (close / close.shift(p['regime_window']) - 1).reindex(sessions)
        if not np.isfinite(momentum.to_numpy()).all():
            raise ValueError('required causal regime features missing')
        regimes = np.where(momentum.to_numpy() >= p['regime_threshold'], 'bull', 'bear')
        holding = False
        active_route = None
        age = 0
        anchor = peak = 0.
        targets, reasons, positions, opportunities, passes = [], [], [], [], []
        for i, regime in enumerate(regimes):
            route = active_route if holding else regime
            rp = p[route]
            row = features[route].iloc[i]
            positions.append(row.range_position)
            eligible = (row.range_position <= rp['entry']
                        and (rp['acf_min'] is None or row.acf1 >= rp['acf_min'])
                        and (rp['momentum_min'] is None or row.momentum20 >= rp['momentum_min']))
            opportunity = not holding and eligible
            passed = c['scope'] not in ('both', regime) or score.iloc[i] >= c['threshold']
            opportunities.append(opportunity)
            passes.append(passed)
            reason = 'flat'
            if holding:
                age += 1
                peak = max(peak, row.close)
                loss = rp['stop_loss'] is not None and row.close / anchor - 1 <= -rp['stop_loss']
                trail = rp['trailing_stop'] is not None and row.close / peak - 1 <= -rp['trailing_stop']
                changed = p['exit_on_regime_change'] and regime != active_route
                if loss or trail or row.range_position >= rp['exit'] or age >= rp['max_hold'] or changed:
                    holding = False
                    reason = ('loss' if loss else 'trailing' if trail else
                              'range' if row.range_position >= rp['exit'] else
                              'time' if age >= rp['max_hold'] else 'regime')
                    active_route = None
                else:
                    reason = 'hold'
            elif eligible:
                if passed:
                    holding = True
                    active_route = regime
                    age = 0
                    anchor = peak = row.close
                    reason = 'entry'
                else:
                    reason = 'confirmation_rejected'
            targets.append(float(holding))
            reasons.append(reason)
        return features['bull'].assign(range_position=positions, target_position=targets,
            signal_reason=reasons, regime=regimes, regime_momentum=momentum,
            bull_range_position=features['bull'].range_position,
            bear_range_position=features['bear'].range_position,
            confirmation_score=score, confirmation_acf=normalized.acf,
            confirmation_turnover=normalized.turnover, confirmation_volume=normalized.volume,
            confirmation_opportunity=opportunities, confirmation_pass=passes)

"""Information gate for state-exit reentry; explicit raw-volume paired checks."""
from collections.abc import Mapping
from dataclasses import replace

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from strategy_runtime import InputContract, ParameterSet
from .confirmed_range import ConfirmedRange, PROFILES, confirmation_features
from .range_reversion import components


class ReentryConfirmedRange(ConfirmedRange):
    def __init__(self, parameters):
        p = parameters.values
        if 'context' not in p or not isinstance(p['context'], Mapping):
            raise ValueError('explicit confirmation context required')
        settings = p['context']
        if set(settings) != {'entry_gate', 'volume_basis', 'weighting'}:
            raise ValueError('exact confirmation context required')
        if settings['entry_gate'] not in ('all', 'regime_reentry') or settings['volume_basis'] not in ('ADJUSTED', 'RAW'):
            raise ValueError('invalid gate context or volume basis')
        if settings['weighting'] not in ('EQUAL_FEATURES', 'EQUAL_BLOCKS'):
            raise ValueError('invalid declared weighting')
        if settings['weighting'] == 'EQUAL_BLOCKS' and p['confirmation']['profile'] != 'all':
            raise ValueError('equal state/participation blocks require the all profile')
        if settings['volume_basis'] == 'RAW' and p['confirmation']['lookback'] != 40:
            raise ValueError('existing raw-volume warmup supports this paired 40-session normalization only')
        super().__init__(ParameterSet({key: value for key, value in p.items() if key != 'context'}))
        self._parameters = parameters

    @property
    def definition(self):
        base = super().definition
        requirements = tuple(replace(item, lookback_sessions=60)
                             if item.name == 'execution' and self._parameters.values['context']['volume_basis'] == 'RAW'
                             else item for item in base.inputs.requirements)
        return replace(base, parameters=self._parameters, inputs=InputContract(requirements))

    def calculate_history(self, inputs, sessions):
        p = self._parameters.values
        c, settings = p['confirmation'], p['context']
        if not c['enabled']:
            return super().calculate_history(inputs, sessions)
        all_features = {key: components(inputs['daily'], p[key]['range_window']) for key in ('bull', 'bear')}
        features = {key: frame.reindex(sessions) for key, frame in all_features.items()}
        if not all(np.isfinite(frame.to_numpy()).all() for frame in features.values()):
            raise ValueError('required causal route features missing')
        score_bars = inputs['daily'].copy()
        if settings['volume_basis'] == 'RAW':
            raw = inputs['execution'].copy()
            raw.index = pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(raw.Date)).normalize()
            score_bars.index = pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(score_bars.Date)).normalize()
            if not raw.index.is_unique or not raw.index.is_monotonic_increasing or not raw.index.isin(score_bars.index).all():
                raise ValueError('raw volume dates must be unique, ordered and share the adjusted calendar')
            adjusted = score_bars.loc[raw.index]
            reconstructed = adjusted.Volume * adjusted.Close / raw.Close
            if not np.allclose(reconstructed.to_numpy(), raw.Volume.to_numpy(), rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-6):
                raise ValueError('per-date raw/HFQ volume conversion differs')
            if not np.allclose(adjusted.Amount.to_numpy(), raw.Amount.to_numpy(), rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-6):
                raise ValueError('amount must be invariant across price-unit conversion')
            score_bars = adjusted.assign(Volume=raw.Volume)
        _, normalized = confirmation_features(score_bars, all_features['bull'].acf1, c['lookback'])
        normalized = normalized.reindex(sessions)
        if not np.isfinite(normalized.to_numpy()).all():
            raise ValueError('complete causal confirmation history missing')
        score = (.5 * normalized.acf + .25 * normalized.turnover + .25 * normalized.volume
                 if settings['weighting'] == 'EQUAL_BLOCKS' else
                 normalized.loc[:, list(PROFILES[c['profile']])].mean(axis=1)) * c['orientation']
        bars = inputs['daily'].copy()
        bars.index = pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(bars.Date)).normalize()
        close = bars.Close.astype(float)
        momentum = (close / close.shift(p['regime_window']) - 1).reindex(sessions)
        if not np.isfinite(momentum.to_numpy()).all():
            raise ValueError('required causal regime features missing')
        regimes = np.where(momentum.to_numpy() >= p['regime_threshold'], 'bull', 'bear')
        holding = False
        active_route = None
        last_exit_reason = None
        age = 0
        anchor = peak = 0.
        targets, reasons, positions, opportunities, passes, contexts = [], [], [], [], [], []
        for i, regime in enumerate(regimes):
            route = active_route if holding else regime
            rp = p[route]
            row = features[route].iloc[i]
            positions.append(row.range_position)
            eligible = (row.range_position <= rp['entry']
                        and (rp['acf_min'] is None or row.acf1 >= rp['acf_min'])
                        and (rp['momentum_min'] is None or row.momentum20 >= rp['momentum_min']))
            applies = (c['scope'] in ('both', regime)
                       and (settings['entry_gate'] == 'all' or last_exit_reason == 'regime'))
            opportunity = not holding and eligible
            passed = not applies or score.iloc[i] >= c['threshold']
            opportunities.append(opportunity)
            passes.append(passed)
            contexts.append(last_exit_reason or 'initial')
            reason = 'flat'
            if holding:
                age += 1
                peak = max(peak, row.close)
                loss = rp['stop_loss'] is not None and row.close / anchor - 1 <= -rp['stop_loss']
                trail = rp['trailing_stop'] is not None and row.close / peak - 1 <= -rp['trailing_stop']
                changed = p['exit_on_regime_change'] and regime != active_route
                if loss or trail or row.range_position >= rp['exit'] or age >= rp['max_hold'] or changed:
                    holding = False
                    reason = ('loss' if loss else 'trailing' if trail else
                              'range' if row.range_position >= rp['exit'] else
                              'time' if age >= rp['max_hold'] else 'regime')
                    last_exit_reason = reason
                    active_route = None
                else:
                    reason = 'hold'
            elif eligible:
                if passed:
                    holding = True
                    active_route = regime
                    age = 0
                    anchor = peak = row.close
                    last_exit_reason = None
                    reason = 'entry'
                else:
                    reason = 'confirmation_rejected'
            targets.append(float(holding))
            reasons.append(reason)
        return features['bull'].assign(range_position=positions, target_position=targets,
            signal_reason=reasons, regime=regimes, regime_momentum=momentum,
            bull_range_position=features['bull'].range_position,
            bear_range_position=features['bear'].range_position,
            confirmation_score=score, confirmation_acf=normalized.acf,
            confirmation_turnover=normalized.turnover, confirmation_volume=normalized.volume,
            confirmation_opportunity=opportunities, confirmation_pass=passes,
            confirmation_exit_context=contexts)

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

def annual(account):
    dates=pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(account.date)).normalize()
    equity=account.equity.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    assert len(equity)==1636 and dates[0]==pd.Timestamp('2020-01-02') and dates[-1]==pd.Timestamp('2026-09-30')
    rows={}
    anchor=1_000_000.
    for year in sorted(set(dates.year)):
        segment=equity[dates.year==year]
        wealth=np.r_[anchor,segment]
        rows[str(year)]={'return':float(segment[-1]/anchor-1),
            'drawdown':float(np.max(1-wealth/np.maximum.accumulate(wealth))),
            'opening_equity':anchor,'closing_equity':float(segment[-1])}
        anchor=float(segment[-1])
    return rows

def _audit_recovery_eligibility(frame, config):
    """Independently derive original/extended eligibility from actual before-state.

    The exception contains no confirmation-score predicate. This is signal
    eligibility authentication, not a forecast or account-profit calculation.
    """
    p = config['payload']['parameters']
    assert config['mechanism'] in ('RAW_BEAR_TIME_BELOW_BODY_ACF_RECOVERY', 'RAW_BEAR_TIME_BELOW_BODY_CLOSE_ACF_RECOVERY')
    assert p['confirmation']['scope'] == 'both' and p['confirmation']['enabled'] is True
    assert p['confirmation']['profile'] == 'all' and p['confirmation']['orientation'] == 1
    assert np.isfinite(frame.acf1.to_numpy()).all(), 'Recovery cannot waive missing raw ACF'
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(frame.entry_acf_value.to_numpy(), frame.acf1.to_numpy())
    assert frame.target_position.isin((0., 1.)).all()
    before_flat = frame.target_position.shift(1, fill_value=0.).eq(0.)
    held_route = frame.regime.where(frame.signal_reason.eq('entry')).shift(1).ffill()
    assert held_route[~before_flat].isin(('bull', 'bear')).all(), 'Held route must follow prior signal entry'
    routes = frame.regime.where(before_flat, held_route)
    assert routes.isin(('bull', 'bear')).all()
    acf_pass = np.array([p[route]['acf_min'] is None or value >= p[route]['acf_min']
                         for route, value in zip(routes, frame.acf1, strict=True)], dtype=bool)
    range_pass = frame.range_position.to_numpy() <= np.array([p[route]['entry'] for route in routes])
    momentum_pass = np.array([p[route]['momentum_min'] is None or value >= p[route]['momentum_min']
                             for route, value in zip(routes, frame.momentum20, strict=True)], dtype=bool)
    body_up = frame.entry_signal_close.gt(frame.entry_signal_open)
    if config['mechanism'] == 'RAW_BEAR_TIME_BELOW_BODY_CLOSE_ACF_RECOVERY':
        body_up = body_up & frame.entry_signal_close.gt(frame.previous_signal_close)
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(body_up.to_numpy(), frame.entry_direction_up.to_numpy())
    category = frame.last_exit_category
    assert (category.isna() | category.isin(('BELOW', 'EQUAL', 'ABOVE'))).all()
    recovery = (before_flat & frame.regime.eq('bear') & frame.last_exit_reason.eq('time')
                & frame.last_exit_route.eq('bear') & category.eq('BELOW') & body_up
                & ~acf_pass & range_pass & momentum_pass)
    eligible = range_pass & momentum_pass & (acf_pass | recovery.to_numpy())
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(acf_pass, frame.entry_acf_pass.to_numpy())
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(recovery.to_numpy(), frame.entry_acf_recovery_applies.to_numpy())
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(eligible, frame.entry_eligible.to_numpy())
    np.testing.assert_array_equal((before_flat & eligible).to_numpy(), frame.confirmation_opportunity.to_numpy())
    assert not frame.entry_direction_gate_applies.any(), 'Recovery has no direction veto'
    assert not frame.signal_reason.eq('entry_direction_rejected').any()
    return {'acf_recovery_opportunities': int(recovery.sum()),
            'original_eligible_flat_opportunities': int((before_flat & range_pass & momentum_pass & acf_pass).sum()),
            'enhanced_eligible_flat_opportunities': int((before_flat & eligible).sum()),
            'holding_eligibility_has_no_exception': True}


def summarize(bound,result,config,ledger):
    run=result.runs[0]
    own,bh=run.execution.account_daily,run.buyhold.account_daily
    pd.testing.assert_series_equal(pd.to_datetime(own.date),pd.to_datetime(bh.date))
    years,benchmark_years=annual(own),annual(bh)
    cagr=float((own.equity.iloc[-1]/1_000_000)**(252/1636)-1)
    bcagr=float((bh.equity.iloc[-1]/1_000_000)**(252/1636)-1)
    assert abs(cagr-run.observation.net_cagr)<1e-12
    closed=int(run.execution.trades.status.eq('CLOSED').sum())
    negative=[y for y in years if benchmark_years[y]['return']<0]
    gates={'return':cagr>=1.5*bcagr if bcagr>0 else cagr>0,
           'annual_drawdown':all(years[y]['drawdown']<benchmark_years[y]['drawdown'] for y in years),
           'frequency':closed*60/1636>=4,
           'negative_buyhold_year_profit':all(years[y]['return']>0 for y in negative)}
    paths=ledger.inspect_run(run)
    audit=ledger.verify_account(bound,result)
    benchmark_paths=ledger.annual_account(run.buyhold.execution)[0]
    assert len(paths['cycles'])==len(run.execution.trades)
    for row in paths['annual_account']:
        assert abs(row['account_return']-years[str(row['year'])]['return'])<1e-12
    for row in benchmark_paths:
        assert abs(row['account_return']-benchmark_years[str(row['year'])]['return'])<1e-12
    frame=run.execution.decisions.copy()
    if config['mode']=='M0':
        masks=None
    else:
        opportunity=frame.confirmation_opportunity.astype(bool)
        if config['mode']=='M1':
            expected=frame.confirmation_score.ge(config['payload']['parameters']['confirmation']['threshold'])
        else:
            direction=1 if config['mode']=='M2' else -1
            expected=(direction*frame.confirmation_delta).ge(0)
        assert np.array_equal(expected,frame.confirmation_pass)
        state_confirmed=pd.Series(True,index=frame.index)
        if config.get('mechanism') in ('RAW_BEAR_TIME_BELOW_BODY_ACF_RECOVERY', 'RAW_BEAR_TIME_BELOW_BODY_CLOSE_ACF_RECOVERY'):
            _audit_recovery_eligibility(frame, config)
        if config.get('mechanism') in ('MEAN_BEAR_TIME_REENTRY_CLOSE','MEAN_BEAR_TIME_REENTRY_BODY'):
            independent=(frame.entry_signal_close.gt(frame.previous_signal_close) if config['mechanism'].endswith('CLOSE')
                         else frame.entry_signal_close.gt(frame.entry_signal_open))
            assert np.array_equal(independent,frame.entry_direction_up)
            applies=opportunity & frame.regime.eq('bear') & frame.last_exit_reason.eq('time') & frame.last_exit_route.eq('bear')
            assert np.array_equal(applies,frame.entry_direction_gate_applies)
            state_confirmed=~applies | independent
        if config.get('mechanism') in ('MEAN_BEAR_TIME_BELOW_CLOSE', 'MEAN_BEAR_TIME_BELOW_BODY',
                                     'MEAN_BEAR_TIME_ABOVE_CLOSE', 'MEAN_BEAR_TIME_ABOVE_BODY',
                                     'MEAN_FIXED120_BEAR_TIME_BELOW_CLOSE', 'MEAN_BEAR_TIME_BELOW_SEGMENT_CLOSE', 'RAW_BEAR_TIME_BELOW_CLOSE', 'RAW_BEAR_TIME_BELOW_BODY'):
            independent=(frame.entry_signal_close.gt(frame.previous_signal_close) if config['mechanism'].endswith('CLOSE')
                         else frame.entry_signal_close.gt(frame.entry_signal_open))
            assert np.array_equal(independent,frame.entry_direction_up)
            category=frame.last_exit_category
            assert (category.isna() | category.isin(('BELOW','EQUAL','ABOVE'))).all(), 'Invalid exit category'
            selected='BELOW' if '_BELOW_' in config['mechanism'] else 'ABOVE'
            applies=(opportunity & frame.regime.eq('bear') & frame.last_exit_reason.eq('time')
                     & frame.last_exit_route.eq('bear') & category.eq(selected))
            assert np.array_equal(applies,frame.entry_direction_gate_applies)
            state_confirmed=~applies | independent
        if config.get('mechanism') in ('NEW_BULL_CLOSE_UP','NEW_BULL_BODY_UP','NEW_BULL_BODY_ANCHOR_LOSS','NEW_BULL_BODY_ANCHOR_LOSS2','MEAN_ACF_NEW_BULL_CLOSE','MEAN_ACF_NEW_BULL_BODY','BEAR_MEAN_ACF_BODY_ADVERSE_TR','BEAR_MEAN_ACF_BODY_ADVERSE_TR2','BEAR_MEAN_ACF_BODY_ADVERSE_TR3'):
            independent=(frame.entry_signal_close.gt(frame.previous_signal_close) if config['mechanism'] in ('NEW_BULL_CLOSE_UP','MEAN_ACF_NEW_BULL_CLOSE')
                         else frame.entry_signal_close.gt(frame.entry_signal_open))
            assert np.array_equal(independent,frame.entry_direction_up)
            applies=frame.regime.eq('bull') & frame.previous_regime.eq('bear')
            assert np.array_equal(applies,frame.entry_direction_gate_applies)
            state_confirmed=~applies | independent
        state_rejected=opportunity & ~state_confirmed
        score_rejected=opportunity & state_confirmed & ~expected
        assert np.array_equal(opportunity & state_confirmed & expected,frame.signal_reason.eq('entry'))
        assert np.array_equal(score_rejected,frame.signal_reason.eq('confirmation_rejected'))
        assert np.array_equal(state_rejected,frame.signal_reason.eq('entry_direction_rejected'))
        masks={'base_opportunities':int(opportunity.sum()),
            'rejected_opportunities':int(score_rejected.sum()),
            'state_rejected_opportunities':int(state_rejected.sum()),
            'raw_score_below_threshold_opportunities':int((opportunity & ~expected).sum()),
            'zero_delta_opportunities':int((opportunity & frame.confirmation_delta.eq(0)).sum())
                 if config['mode'] in ('M2','M3') else None,
            'groups':frame.assign(year=pd.to_datetime(frame.signal_date).dt.year,
                                 opportunity=opportunity.astype(int),rejected=score_rejected.astype(int),
                                 state_rejected=state_rejected.astype(int))
                .groupby(['year','regime'])[['opportunity','rejected','state_rejected']].sum().reset_index().to_dict('records')}
    if config.get('mechanism') in ('RAW_BEAR_TIME_BELOW_BODY_ACF_RECOVERY', 'RAW_BEAR_TIME_BELOW_BODY_CLOSE_ACF_RECOVERY'):
        masks.update(_audit_recovery_eligibility(frame, config))
    actual_buys=run.execution.fills.side.eq('BUY')
    full_wealth=np.r_[1_000_000.,own.equity.to_numpy()]
    drawdown=float(np.max(1-full_wealth/np.maximum.accumulate(full_wealth)))
    row={key:config[key] for key in ('index','background','mode','candidate_id','content_sha256','existing_identity')}
    row.update(net_cagr=cagr,drawdown=drawdown,closed_trades=closed,frequency60=closed*60/1636,
        annual=years,benchmark_cagr=bcagr,benchmark_annual=benchmark_years,
        negative_benchmark_years=negative,gates=gates,qualified=all(gates.values()),
        total_fees=float(run.execution.fills.fees.sum()),
        signal_entries=int(frame.signal_reason.eq('entry').sum()),buy_fills=int(actual_buys.sum()),
        final_quantity=int(own.quantity.iloc[-1]),gate_counts=masks,paths=paths,account_audit=audit,
        request_hash=result.request_hash,result_hash=result.result_hash,
        raw_input_bindings={key:value.to_dict() for key,value in bound.input_bindings.items()},
        order_statuses={str(k):int(v) for k,v in run.execution.orders.status.value_counts().items()})
    return row,frame

def paired(first,second,label):
    # Difference is full policy outcome, not a sum of rejected predecessor trades.
    result={'comparison':label,'first':first['background']+'/'+first['mode'],
        'second':second['background']+'/'+second['mode'],
        'cagr_difference':second['net_cagr']-first['net_cagr'],
        'drawdown_difference':second['drawdown']-first['drawdown'],
        'closed_trade_difference':second['closed_trades']-first['closed_trades'],
        'annual_differences':{}}
    a={str(x['year']):x for x in first['paths']['annual_account']}
    b={str(x['year']):x for x in second['paths']['annual_account']}
    for year in a:
        result['annual_differences'][year]={'net_return':b[year]['account_return']-a[year]['account_return'],
            'price_contribution':b[year]['price_contribution']-a[year]['price_contribution'],
            'fee_contribution':b[year]['fee_contribution']-a[year]['fee_contribution']}
    def key(cycle):
        return (cycle['entry_fill_time'],cycle.get('exit_fill_time'),cycle['entry_route'])
    old={key(c):c for c in first['paths']['cycles']}
    new={key(c):c for c in second['paths']['cycles']}
    removed=[c for k,c in old.items() if k not in new]
    added=[c for k,c in new.items() if k not in old]
    result['cycle_changes']={'same_entry_exit_route':len(set(old)&set(new)),
        'removed_or_retimed':removed,'added_or_retimed':added,
        'warning':'different paths inherit different cash; old-cycle pnl is descriptive, not additive policy contribution'}
    return result
