import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import types

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = next(p for p in HERE.parents if (p / "research/S013/experiments").is_dir())
OLD_SRC = ROOT / "research/S013/experiments/EX055_20261011/src"
OLD_PROTOCOLS = OLD_SRC.parent / "protocols"
OLD_RUNS = ROOT / "research/S013/assets/runs/EX055_20261011"
NEW_SOURCE = ROOT / ".tmp/ex056-dual-recovery-prototype/strategy_runtime"
NEW_ORACLE = ROOT / ".tmp/ex056-dual-recovery-oracle/dual_recovery_oracle.py"
OLD_MECHANISM = "RAW_BEAR_TIME_BELOW_BODY_ACF_RECOVERY"
NEW_MECHANISM = "RAW_BEAR_TIME_BELOW_BODY_CLOSE_ACF_RECOVERY"
V1 = ROOT / ".tmp/ex056-center-equivalence"
V1_REF = (
    "research/S013/experiments/EX056_20261011/protocols/center_equivalence_method_reference.json"
)
FAILURE_REF = (
    "research/S013/experiments/EX056_20261011/protocols/center_equivalence_failure_reference.json"
)
EXIT_FIELDS = {
    "last_exit_reason": frozenset(("loss", "trailing", "range", "time", "regime")),
    "last_exit_route": frozenset(("bull", "bear")),
    "last_exit_category": frozenset(("BELOW", "EQUAL", "ABOVE")),
}
PUBLIC_METHOD = (
    "research/S013/experiments/EX056_20261011/protocols/center_equivalence_v2_method_reference.json"
)


def digest(path):
    return sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def read_json(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text("utf-8-sig"))


def standard(value):
    """No general missing/NaN cleanup: nullable metadata is explicitly None."""
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {str(k): standard(v) for k, v in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
        return [standard(v) for v in value]
    if isinstance(value, (pd.Timestamp, np.datetime64)):
        assert not pd.isna(value)
        return pd.Timestamp(value).isoformat()
    if isinstance(value, np.generic):
        return standard(value.item())
    if isinstance(value, float):
        assert np.isfinite(value), "Nonfinite number cannot be retained"
    if value is pd.NA or value is pd.NaT:
        raise AssertionError("Missing value must be explicit None")
    return value


def write_json(path, value):
    path = Path(path)
    assert not path.exists(), "Never overwrite prior proof/result"
    path.write_text(
        json.dumps(standard(value), indent=2, ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False) + "\n", "utf-8"
    )


def load(name, path):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[name] = module
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


def pure_induction(frame, p):
    """Own common-state recurrence, not a financial or order replay.

    The old BODY recovery can differ from dual recovery only at original ACF
    failure with range/momentum/context/body eligibility. Require Close-up at
    EVERY such day, before score, and reconstruct both equal next states.
    """
    assert p["mechanism"] == OLD_MECHANISM
    assert p["context"] == {
        "entry_gate": "all",
        "volume_basis": "ADJUSTED",
        "weighting": "EQUAL_BLOCKS",
    }
    c = p["confirmation"]
    assert c["enabled"] and c["scope"] == "both"
    assert all(p[r]["cooldown"] == 0 for r in ("bull", "bear"))
    assert frame.index.is_unique and frame.index.is_monotonic_increasing and len(frame)
    holding, active, age, anchor, peak, last, last_route, category = (
        False,
        None,
        0,
        None,
        None,
        None,
        None,
        None,
    )
    records, recovery = [], []
    for i, row in enumerate(frame.itertuples()):
        for field in (
            "close",
            "entry_signal_close",
            "entry_signal_open",
            "previous_signal_close",
            "acf1",
            "momentum20",
            "confirmation_score",
            "bull_range_position",
            "bear_range_position",
        ):
            assert np.isfinite(getattr(row, field)), field
        assert (
            row.close == row.entry_signal_close > 0
            and row.entry_signal_open > 0
            and row.previous_signal_close > 0
        )
        assert row.regime in ("bull", "bear")
        assert (row.last_exit_reason, row.last_exit_route, row.last_exit_category) == (
            last,
            last_route,
            category,
        )
        route = active if holding else row.regime
        rp = p[route]
        position = getattr(row, route + "_range_position")
        before = (
            holding,
            active,
            age if holding else 0,
            anchor if holding else None,
            peak if holding else None,
            last,
            last_route,
            category,
        )
        acf_pass = rp["acf_min"] is None or row.acf1 >= rp["acf_min"]
        range_pass = position <= rp["entry"]
        momentum_pass = rp["momentum_min"] is None or row.momentum20 >= rp["momentum_min"]
        body = row.entry_signal_close > row.entry_signal_open
        close_up = row.entry_signal_close > row.previous_signal_close
        context = (
            not holding
            and row.regime == "bear"
            and last == "time"
            and last_route == "bear"
            and category == "BELOW"
        )
        old_recovery = bool(range_pass and momentum_pass and not acf_pass and context and body)
        new_recovery = bool(old_recovery and close_up)
        assert not old_recovery or close_up, (
            "Old recovery day lacks strict Close-up: equivalence theorem inapplicable"
        )
        old_eligible = bool(range_pass and momentum_pass and (acf_pass or context and body))
        new_eligible = bool(
            range_pass and momentum_pass and (acf_pass or context and body and close_up)
        )
        assert old_eligible == new_eligible and old_recovery == new_recovery
        score_pass = row.confirmation_score >= c["threshold"]
        opportunity = not holding and old_eligible
        assert bool(row.entry_acf_pass) == bool(acf_pass)
        assert row.entry_acf_value == row.acf1
        assert bool(row.entry_acf_recovery_applies) == old_recovery
        assert bool(row.entry_eligible) == old_eligible
        assert bool(row.confirmation_opportunity) == opportunity
        assert bool(row.confirmation_pass) == score_pass
        assert bool(row.entry_direction_up) == body
        assert not row.entry_direction_gate_applies
        assert row.confirmation_exit_context == (last or "initial")
        reason = "flat"
        if holding:
            age += 1
            peak = max(peak, row.close)
            loss = rp["stop_loss"] is not None and row.close / anchor - 1 <= -rp["stop_loss"]
            trail = rp["trailing_stop"] is not None and row.close / peak - 1 <= -rp["trailing_stop"]
            reason = (
                "loss"
                if loss
                else "trailing"
                if trail
                else "range"
                if position >= rp["exit"]
                else "time"
                if age >= rp["max_hold"]
                else "regime"
                if p["exit_on_regime_change"] and row.regime != active
                else "hold"
            )
            if reason != "hold":
                category = (
                    ("BELOW" if row.close < anchor else "ABOVE" if row.close > anchor else "EQUAL")
                    if reason == "time" and active == "bear"
                    else None
                )
                holding, last, last_route, active = False, reason, active, None
        elif old_eligible:
            reason = "entry" if score_pass else "confirmation_rejected"
            if score_pass:
                holding, active, age, anchor, peak = True, row.regime, 0, row.close, row.close
                last = last_route = category = None
        assert reason == row.signal_reason and float(holding) == row.target_position
        after = (
            holding,
            active,
            age if holding else 0,
            anchor if holding else None,
            peak if holding else None,
            last,
            last_route,
            category,
        )
        record = {
            "index": i,
            "signal_date": frame.index[i],
            "raw_route": row.regime,
            "before": before,
            "after": after,
            "old_eligible": old_eligible,
            "new_eligible": new_eligible,
            "old_recovery": old_recovery,
            "new_recovery": new_recovery,
            "score_pass": bool(score_pass),
            "body_up": bool(body),
            "close_up": bool(close_up),
            "signal_reason": reason,
            "target": float(holding),
            "entry_signal_close": row.entry_signal_close,
            "entry_signal_open": row.entry_signal_open,
            "previous_signal_close": row.previous_signal_close,
        }
        records.append(record)
        if old_recovery:
            recovery.append(record)
    groups = []
    years = sorted(set(frame.index.year))
    for year in ("ALL", *map(str, years)):
        for route in ("bull", "bear"):
            rows = [
                r
                for r in records
                if (year == "ALL" or str(r["signal_date"].year) == year) and r["raw_route"] == route
            ]
            rec = [r for r in rows if r["old_recovery"]]
            groups.append(
                {
                    "signal_year": year,
                    "raw_route": route,
                    "signal_days": len(rows),
                    "recovery_opportunities": len(rec),
                    "recovery_entries": sum(r["signal_reason"] == "entry" for r in rec),
                    "recovery_score_rejections": sum(
                        r["signal_reason"] == "confirmation_rejected" for r in rec
                    ),
                }
            )
    assert sum(r["signal_days"] for r in groups if r["signal_year"] == "ALL") == len(frame)
    assert sum(r["signal_days"] for r in groups if r["signal_year"] != "ALL") == len(frame)
    return {
        "status": "PASS",
        "all_days": records,
        "recovery_events": recovery,
        "groups": groups,
        "all_recovery_close_up": True,
        "same_state_induction_days": len(records),
        "terminal_common_state": records[-1]["after"],
    }


def canonical_exit_metadata(frame):
    """Only three nullable storage columns; reject counterfeit non-null meanings."""
    assert frame.columns.is_unique and set(EXIT_FIELDS).issubset(frame.columns)
    output, audit = frame.copy(), {}
    for name, allowed in EXIT_FIELDS.items():
        values = []
        for value in frame[name].to_numpy():
            if (
                value is None
                or value is pd.NA
                or (isinstance(value, (float, np.floating)) and np.isnan(value))
            ):
                values.append(None)
            else:
                assert isinstance(value, str) and value in allowed, (name, value)
                values.append(value)
        output[name] = pd.Series(values, index=frame.index, dtype=object)
        audit[name] = {
            "original_dtype": str(frame[name].dtype),
            "canonical_dtype": "object",
            "semantic_null_count": values.count(None),
        }
    for reason, route, category in output.loc[:, list(EXIT_FIELDS)].itertuples(
        index=False, name=None
    ):
        assert (reason is None) == (route is None)
        if reason == "time" and route == "bear":
            assert category in EXIT_FIELDS["last_exit_category"]
        else:
            assert category is None
    return output, audit


def public_action_audit(native, new_signals):
    """Existing public BUY/SELL/HOLD encoding, never execute an order."""
    assert "action" in native and native.action.isin(("BUY", "SELL", "HOLD")).all()
    assert len(native) == len(new_signals) and len(native)
    computed = []
    for frame in (native, new_signals):
        values = frame.target_position.to_numpy(dtype=float)
        assert np.isfinite(values).all() and np.isin(values, (0.0, 1.0)).all()
        previous = np.r_[0.0, values[:-1]]
        computed.append(
            np.where(values > previous, "BUY", np.where(values < previous, "SELL", "HOLD"))
        )
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(native.action.to_numpy(), computed[0])
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(computed[0], computed[1])
    return {
        "status": "PASS",
        "encoding": "Strict target-change BUY/SELL/otherwise HOLD; signal only",
        "counts": {
            action: int(np.count_nonzero(computed[0] == action))
            for action in ("BUY", "SELL", "HOLD")
        },
    }


def compare_histories(old, new):
    pd.testing.assert_index_equal(old.index, new.index, exact=True)
    assert list(old.columns) == list(new.columns), (
        "Only declared diagnostic change allowed, no missing fields"
    )
    old, old_null_audit = canonical_exit_metadata(old)
    new, new_null_audit = canonical_exit_metadata(new)
    compared = [c for c in old if c != "entry_direction_up"]
    pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(old[compared], new[compared], check_exact=True)
    assert np.array_equal(old.entry_direction_up, old.entry_signal_close.gt(old.entry_signal_open))
    assert np.array_equal(
        new.entry_direction_up,
        new.entry_signal_close.gt(new.entry_signal_open)
        & new.entry_signal_close.gt(new.previous_signal_close),
    )
    assert not (
        old.entry_acf_recovery_applies & old.entry_direction_up.ne(new.entry_direction_up)
    ).any()
    return {
        "status": "EXACT_SIGNAL_EQUIVALENCE",
        "signal_days": len(old),
        "exact_fields": compared,
        "allowed_diagnostic_fields": ["entry_direction_up"],
        "diagnostic_different_days": int(old.entry_direction_up.ne(new.entry_direction_up).sum()),
        "target_different_days": 0,
        "reason_different_days": 0,
        "nullable_storage_correction_only": {
            "fields": list(EXIT_FIELDS),
            "old": old_null_audit,
            "new": new_null_audit,
            "all_other_dtype_value_checks": "EXACT_UNCHANGED",
        },
    }


def authenticate_hashes(method):
    for group in ("source_files", "metadata_inputs"):
        for relative, expected in method[group].items():
            assert digest(ROOT / relative) == expected, relative


def authenticate_failure_chain(method=None):
    from czsc_trader.research_tools.evidence import EvidenceRef

    references, documents = [], []
    for relative in (V1_REF, FAILURE_REF):
        ref = EvidenceRef.from_dict(read_json(ROOT / relative))
        assert (
            ref.experiment.strategy_id == "S013"
            and ref.experiment.experiment_id == "EX056_20261011"
        )
        assert digest(ref.resolve(ROOT)) == ref.sha256
        references.append(ref.to_dict())
        documents.append(read_json(ref.resolve(ROOT)))
    prior, failure = documents
    assert prior == read_json(V1 / "method_draft.json")
    authenticate_hashes(prior)
    assert failure["status"] == "FAILED" and failure["result_pass_file_exists"] is False
    assert failure["actual_tool_result"]["exit_code"] == 1
    assert failure["phase"] == "compare_histories(old_model, dual)"
    assert failure["method_reference"] == references[0]
    assert failure["source_sha256"] == digest(V1 / "equivalence.py")
    assert failure["source"] == (V1 / "equivalence.py").read_text("utf-8")
    if method is not None:
        assert method["failed_v1_method_reference"] == references[0]
        assert method["failed_v1_execution_reference"] == references[1]
        assert method["failed_v1_source_sha256"] == failure["source_sha256"]
        assert method["prior_v1_method_document"] == prior
        assert method["prior_v1_failure_document"] == failure
    return references, documents


def method_guard(path):
    """Public exact method retention is checked before loading old cache or data."""
    from czsc_trader.research_tools.evidence import EvidenceRef

    method = read_json(path)
    authenticate_hashes(method)
    ref = EvidenceRef.from_dict(read_json(ROOT / method["public_method_reference_path"]))
    assert ref.experiment.strategy_id == "S013" and ref.experiment.experiment_id == "EX056_20261011"
    assert digest(ref.resolve(ROOT)) == ref.sha256
    assert read_json(ref.resolve(ROOT)) == method
    authenticate_failure_chain(method)
    return method, ref


def build_method():
    """Small old metadata and pure source material only; never read old cache/account bytes."""
    plan = read_json(OLD_PROTOCOLS / "plan.json")
    prior_references, prior_documents = authenticate_failure_chain()
    paths = [
        HERE / "equivalence.py",
        HERE / "focused_checks.py",
        OLD_SRC / "common.py",
        OLD_SRC / "raw_recovery_oracle.py",
        NEW_ORACLE,
    ]
    paths += [OLD_SRC / name for name in plan["source_files"]]
    paths += [ROOT / name for name in plan["external_source_files"]]
    paths += list(NEW_SOURCE.rglob("*.py"))
    paths += [V1 / "equivalence.py", V1 / "focused_checks.py"]
    pure_materials = {}
    for folder in (
        "ex056-dual-recovery-prototype",
        "ex056-dual-recovery-oracle",
        "ex056-param-prototype",
        "ex056-param-checks",
    ):
        for path in sorted((ROOT / ".tmp" / folder).rglob("*")):
            if (
                path.is_file()
                and path.suffix in (".py", ".json")
                and "__pycache__" not in path.parts
            ):
                pure_materials[path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()] = {
                    "sha256": digest(path),
                    "content": path.read_text("utf-8-sig"),
                }
    metadata = [
        OLD_PROTOCOLS / "plan.json",
        OLD_RUNS / "account_references.json",
        OLD_RUNS / "precheck.json",
        OLD_RUNS / "analysis.json",
        HERE / "focused.json",
        V1 / "method_draft.json",
        ROOT / V1_REF,
        ROOT / FAILURE_REF,
        ROOT / "research/S013/experiments/EX056_20261011/protocols/center_equivalence_failure.json",
    ]
    return {
        "status": "PURE_METHOD_READY_NULLABLE_STORAGE_SUCCESSOR_NOT_NEW_FINANCIAL_EVALUATION",
        "failed_v1_method_reference": prior_references[0],
        "failed_v1_execution_reference": prior_references[1],
        "failed_v1_source_sha256": prior_documents[1]["source_sha256"],
        "prior_v1_method_document": prior_documents[0],
        "prior_v1_failure_document": prior_documents[1],
        "storage_correction": "Only last_exit_reason/route/category after strict allowed-string/null and legal-context checks convert storage NaN/pd.NA/None to semantic None in object columns. Every other dtype/value/index/column/core-state check unchanged. Wrong nonnull/change/missing/extra remains rejected; public BUY/SELL/HOLD target-change encoding validated. No financial or strategy-rule correction.",
        "batch": "S013",
        "old_center": {
            "candidate_id": "C7980",
            "label": "N0",
            "mechanism": OLD_MECHANISM,
            "account_reference": read_json(OLD_RUNS / "account_references.json")["N0"],
        },
        "new_signal_mechanism": NEW_MECHANISM,
        "new_candidate_identity_note": "C8280 only typed prospective signal-source identity; never a registered or evaluated account",
        "public_method_reference_path": PUBLIC_METHOD,
        "source_files": {p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(): digest(p) for p in sorted(set(paths))},
        "metadata_inputs": {p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(): digest(p) for p in metadata},
        "pure_materials": pure_materials,
        "pure_focused_proof": read_json(HERE / "focused.json"),
        "financial_preparations": 0,
        "financial_evaluations": 0,
        "authentication": "Old public EvaluationEvidence SHA/validate/exact formal serialization; public runtime identity/payload/source/dependencies/request/lineage/inputbinding; prepared-only daily/calendar fetch; independent old55 formula/state/date audit. No new cash policy or order replay.",
        "comparison": "Calculate new56 signal history directly from old prepared input/full daily at identical dates and all13 numeric center; independent frozen dual oracle pure reconstruction; every column exact except explicitly allowed dual entry_direction_up diagnostic.",
        "theorem": "Common empty initial state; each day all old actual ACF-failing eligible recovery opportunities satisfy strict Close>previousClose before score. Thus both eligible/recovery booleans match including score rejections, identical holding priorities give identical reason/target and nextstate; induction over every day. If this predicate fails, abort rather than claiming equivalence.",
        "limits": "Center-only existing-input signal equivalence, not new native financial evaluation, not 32-point equivalence, not parameter robustness/independent validation. Old55 economic metrics remain old55 facts with old EvidenceRef. No invented56 returns, fees, orders, or business evaluations. Pure history including failures is retained, not erased.",
    }


def main(method_path):
    # All actual cache/financial bytes are below this public-retention guard.
    method, method_ref = method_guard(method_path)
    from dataflows import canonical_frame_sha256
    from strategy_runtime import (
        ParameterSet,
        StrategyCandidate,
        canonical_sha256,
        implementation_sha256,
    )
    from czsc_trader.research_tools.evidence import EvidenceRef
    from czsc_trader.research_tools.evaluation import (
        serialize_evaluation_evidence,
        validate_evaluation_evidence,
    )

    sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
    sys.path.insert(0, str(OLD_SRC))
    common = load("common", OLD_SRC / "common.py")
    old_oracle = load("_ex056_equivalence_old55", OLD_SRC / "raw_recovery_oracle.py")
    new_oracle = load("_ex056_equivalence_independent", NEW_ORACLE)
    ctx = common.context(1)
    plan = read_json(OLD_PROTOCOLS / "plan.json")
    cfg = next(c for c in plan["configurations"] if c["label"] == "N0")
    assert cfg["candidate_id"] == "C7980" and cfg["mechanism"] == OLD_MECHANISM
    bound, result = common.cache_read(common.CACHE / "N0.pkl.gz")
    ref = EvidenceRef.from_dict(method["old_center"]["account_reference"])
    assert ref.to_dict() == read_json(OLD_RUNS / "account_references.json")["N0"]
    assert ref.experiment.strategy_id == "S013" and ref.experiment.experiment_id == "EX055_20261011"
    assert digest(ref.resolve(ROOT)) == ref.sha256
    formal = read_json(ref.resolve(ROOT))
    validate_evaluation_evidence(formal)
    assert serialize_evaluation_evidence(bound, result) == formal
    assert len(result.runs) == 1 and bound.strategy.candidate_id == "C7980"
    assert canonical_sha256(bound.strategy.payload) == canonical_sha256(cfg["payload"])
    assert tuple(bound.dependencies) == common.DEPENDENCIES
    identity = ctx.runtime.identify(bound.strategy, dependencies=bound.dependencies)
    assert (
        identity.content_sha256 == cfg["content_sha256"] == result.runs[0].identity.content_sha256
    )
    assert identity.source_sha256 == cfg["payload"]["runtime"]["source_sha256"]
    precheck = read_json(OLD_RUNS / "precheck.json")
    original_summary = read_json(OLD_RUNS / "analysis.json")["rows"]["N0"]
    assert (
        result.request_hash == original_summary["request_hash"]
        and result.result_hash == original_summary["result_hash"]
    )
    assert (
        precheck["status"] == "PASS"
        and precheck["configuration"] == "N0"
        and precheck["result_hash"] == result.result_hash
        and precheck["provider_calls"] == []
    )
    native = result.runs[0].execution.decisions
    old_audit = old_oracle.audit_raw_recovery(ctx, bound, native, cfg["payload"]["parameters"])
    assert old_audit["status"] == "PASS" and not common.SOURCE_CALLS
    binding = next(iter(bound.input_bindings.values()))
    assert binding.prepared is not None
    request = binding.plan.requests["daily"]
    fetched = ctx.data.fetch(request, prepared=binding.prepared)
    assert fetched.ready and not common.SOURCE_CALLS
    assert canonical_frame_sha256(fetched.dataframe) == fetched.identity.content_sha256
    assert (
        fetched.identity.dataset == str(request.dataset)
        and fetched.identity.symbol == request.symbol == "510500.SH"
    )
    bars = fetched.dataframe.copy()
    bars.index = pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(bars.Date)).normalize()
    dates = pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(native.signal_date)).normalize()
    assert (
        bars.index.is_unique and bars.index.is_monotonic_increasing and dates.isin(bars.index).all()
    )
    assert bars.index[-1] == dates[-1]
    old_parameters = deepcopy(cfg["payload"]["parameters"])
    new_parameters = {**deepcopy(old_parameters), "mechanism": NEW_MECHANISM}
    new_payload = {
        "parameters": new_parameters,
        "runtime": {
            "contract_version": 1,
            "module": "strategy_runtime.strategies.bear_time_below_dual_recovery_range",
            "qualname": "BearTimeBelowDualRecoveryRange",
            "source_files": sorted(
                p.relative_to(NEW_SOURCE).as_posix() for p in NEW_SOURCE.rglob("*.py")
            ),
        },
    }
    new_payload["runtime"]["source_sha256"] = implementation_sha256(
        new_payload["runtime"]["source_files"], source_root=NEW_SOURCE
    )
    # Public source identity only: no new EvaluationRequest, Bound, plan, registration or evaluation.
    prospective_identity = ctx.runtime.identify(
        StrategyCandidate("S013", "C8280", new_payload, NEW_SOURCE), dependencies=bound.dependencies
    )
    assert prospective_identity.source_sha256 == new_payload["runtime"]["source_sha256"]
    package = types.ModuleType("_ex056_equivalence_native")
    package.__path__ = [str(NEW_SOURCE / "strategies")]
    sys.modules[package.__name__] = package
    runtime_module = load(
        package.__name__ + ".bear_time_below_dual_recovery_range",
        NEW_SOURCE / "strategies/bear_time_below_dual_recovery_range.py",
    )
    dual = runtime_module.BearTimeBelowDualRecoveryRange(
        ParameterSet(new_parameters)
    ).calculate_history({"daily": bars}, dates)
    old_expected = old_oracle._reconstruct(bars, dates, old_parameters)
    new_expected = new_oracle._reconstruct(bars, dates, new_parameters)
    internals = {"holding_before", "route_before", "age_before", "active_route", "eligible"}
    audited = [c for c in new_expected if c not in internals]
    for field in audited:
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(
            dual[field].to_numpy(), new_expected[field].to_numpy(), err_msg=field
        )
    # Old native frame has execution additions; all old model columns are exact.
    old_model = native.loc[:, list(dual.columns)].copy()
    old_model.index = dates
    comparison = compare_histories(old_model, dual)
    old_model, _ = canonical_exit_metadata(old_model)
    induction = pure_induction(old_model, old_parameters)
    actions = public_action_audit(native, dual)
    for record in induction["all_days"]:
        row = native.iloc[record["index"]]
        record["valid_session"] = pd.Timestamp(row.valid_session)
        record["old_decision_id"] = str(row.decision_id)
    for field in new_expected:
        if field != "entry_direction_up":
            np.testing.assert_array_equal(
                old_expected[field].to_numpy(), new_expected[field].to_numpy(), err_msg=field
            )
    assert not common.SOURCE_CALLS
    authenticate_hashes(method)
    output = {
        "status": "PASS",
        "result_kind": "CENTER_SIGNAL_EQUIVALENCE_ONLY",
        "core_signal_path_exact": True,
        "allowed_diagnostic_differences": ["entry_direction_up"],
        "economic_account_evaluations": 0,
        "original_evaluation_reference": ref.to_dict(),
        "method_reference": method_ref.to_dict(),
        "input_account_reference": ref.to_dict(),
        "new_account_evaluations": 0,
        "new_account_preparations": 0,
        "new_account_replays": 0,
        "provider_calls": common.SOURCE_CALLS,
        "comparison": comparison,
        "induction": induction,
        "public_action_audit": actions,
        "failed_v1_method_reference": method["failed_v1_method_reference"],
        "failed_v1_execution_reference": method["failed_v1_execution_reference"],
        "nullable_storage_correction": method["storage_correction"],
        "old_native_authentication": {
            "public_identity": identity.to_dict(),
            "request_hash": result.request_hash,
            "result_hash": result.result_hash,
            "runtime_binding_hash": result.runtime_binding_hash,
            "formal_serialization": "EXACT_EQUAL",
            "formal_lineage": formal["request_identity"].get("lineage"),
            "formal_parameter_binding": formal["request_identity"].get("parameter_binding"),
            "calendar_and_input_audit": old_audit,
        },
        "uncached56_signal_source_identity": prospective_identity.to_dict(),
        "new_signal_independent_oracle": {
            "status": "PASS",
            "audited_fields": audited,
            "source_sha256": digest(NEW_ORACLE),
        },
        "old55_economic_reference_only": {
            "candidate_id": "C7980",
            "reference": ref.to_dict(),
            "analysis_path": (OLD_RUNS / "analysis.json").relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),
            "analysis_sha256": digest(OLD_RUNS / "analysis.json"),
            "qualified": original_summary["qualified"],
            "gates": original_summary["gates"],
        },
        "limits": method["limits"],
        "source_files": method["source_files"],
    }
    write_json(HERE / "result.json", output)
    print(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "status": output["status"],
                "signal_days": len(dates),
                "recovery_events": len(induction["recovery_events"]),
                "diagnostic_different_days": comparison["diagnostic_different_days"],
                "new_account_evaluations": 0,
            }
        )
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--build-method", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--method", type=Path, default=HERE / "method_draft.json")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.build_method:
        write_json(HERE / "method_draft.json", build_method())
    else:
        main(args.method)

"""Synthetic center-equivalence theorem and method guard checks; zero native reads."""

from copy import deepcopy
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import traceback
import types
from unittest.mock import patch

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = next(p for p in HERE.parents if (p / "research/S013/experiments").is_dir())
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True


def load(name, path):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[name] = module
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


def main():
    common = types.ModuleType("common")
    common.SOURCE_CALLS = []
    sys.modules["common"] = common
    tool = load("_ex056_center_equivalence", HERE / "equivalence.py")
    old = load(
        "_ex056_equivalence_pure_old",
        ROOT / "research/S013/experiments/EX055_20261011/src/raw_recovery_oracle.py",
    )
    dual = load(
        "_ex056_equivalence_pure_dual",
        ROOT / ".tmp/ex056-dual-recovery-oracle/dual_recovery_oracle.py",
    )
    plan = json.loads(
        (ROOT / "research/S013/experiments/EX012_20261011/protocols/plan.json").read_text("utf-8")
    )
    p = deepcopy(
        next(
            row["payload"]["parameters"]
            for row in plan["configurations"]
            if row["candidate_id"] == "C2132"
        )
    )
    p.update(mechanism=tool.OLD_MECHANISM)
    p["bear"]["max_hold"] = 1
    checks, refusals = [], []

    def check(label, condition=True):
        assert condition, label
        checks.append(label)

    def refuse(label, call, expected=(AssertionError, FileNotFoundError, ValueError, TypeError)):
        try:
            call()
        except expected:
            refusals.append(label)
        else:
            raise AssertionError("Expected refusal: " + label)

    def fixture(closes, opens, acfs, scores=None, routes=None, positions=None):
        count = len(closes)
        dates = pd.bdate_range("2030-12-26", periods=count)
        return pd.DataFrame(
            {
                "acf1": acfs,
                "close": closes,
                "momentum20": 0.0,
                "regime": ["bear"] * count if routes is None else routes,
                "bull_range_position": 0.5,
                "bear_range_position": 0.5 if positions is None else positions,
                "confirmation_score": [0.0] * count if scores is None else scores,
                "entry_signal_close": closes,
                "entry_signal_open": opens,
                "previous_signal_close": [10.0, *closes[:-1]],
                "entry_direction_up": np.asarray(closes) > np.asarray(opens),
            },
            index=dates,
        )

    def both(features, parameters=None):
        params = p if parameters is None else parameters
        first = old._state_path(features, params)
        other = features.copy()
        other["entry_direction_up"] = other.entry_signal_close.gt(
            other.entry_signal_open
        ) & other.entry_signal_close.gt(other.previous_signal_close)
        second = dual._state_path(other, {**deepcopy(params), "mechanism": tool.NEW_MECHANISM})
        return first, second

    first, second = both(
        fixture(
            [9.0, 8.0, 8.1, 8.2, 8.3],
            [10.0, 10.0, 7.0, 7.0, 7.0],

PROFILES = {

def causal_rank(values, window):
    """S007-v1 midrank formula; complete trailing window, centered on zero."""

    def last(items):
        current = items[-1]
        return float(
            (np.count_nonzero(items < current) + 0.5 * np.count_nonzero(items == current))
            / len(items)
            - 0.5
        )

    return values.rolling(window, min_periods=window).apply(last, raw=True)


def confirmation_features(bars, acf, window):
    frame = bars.copy()
    frame.index = pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(frame.Date)).normalize()
    volume, amount = frame.Volume.astype(float), frame.Amount.astype(float)
    if (
        not np.isfinite(volume).all()
        or not np.isfinite(amount).all()
        or (volume <= 0).any()
        or (amount <= 0).any()
    ):
        raise ValueError("confirmation requires finite positive volume and amount")
    raw = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "acf": acf,
            "turnover": amount / amount.rolling(20).mean(),
            "volume": np.log(volume).diff().rolling(20).mean(),
        },
        index=frame.index,
    )
    return raw, raw.apply(lambda values: causal_rank(values, window))

def components(frame, range_window=60):
    bars = frame.copy()
    bars.index = pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(bars.Date)).normalize()
    if not bars.index.is_unique or not bars.index.is_monotonic_increasing:
        raise ValueError("daily input must be unique and ordered")
    close = bars.Close.astype(float)
    low = bars.Low.rolling(range_window).min()
    high = bars.High.rolling(range_window).max()
    position = (close - low) / (high - low)

    def acf(values):
        centered = values - values.mean()
        variance = np.mean(centered**2)
        return (
            np.nan
            if np.isclose(variance, 0)
            else float(np.dot(centered[1:], centered[:-1]) / 19 / variance)
        )

    persistence = close.pct_change(fill_method=None).rolling(20).apply(acf, raw=True)
    return pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "range_position": position,
            "acf1": persistence,
            "close": close,
            "momentum20": close / close.shift(20) - 1,
        },
        index=bars.index,
    )

def load(source, name, file):
    package = types.ModuleType(name)
    package.__path__ = [str(source / "strategies")]
    sys.modules[name] = package
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
        name + "." + file, source / "strategies" / (file + ".py")
    )
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[spec.name] = module
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module

def load(source, name, file):
    package = types.ModuleType(name)
    package.__path__ = [str(source / "strategies")]
    sys.modules[name] = package
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
        name + "." + file, source / "strategies" / (file + ".py")
    )
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[spec.name] = module
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module

def components(frame, range_window=60):
    bars = frame.copy()
    bars.index = pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(bars.Date)).normalize()
    if not bars.index.is_unique or not bars.index.is_monotonic_increasing:
        raise ValueError('daily input must be unique and ordered')
    close = bars.Close.astype(float)
    low = bars.Low.rolling(range_window).min()
    high = bars.High.rolling(range_window).max()
    position = (close-low)/(high-low)

        centered = values-values.mean()
        variance = np.mean(centered**2)
        return np.nan if np.isclose(variance,0) else float(np.dot(centered[1:], centered[:-1])/19/variance)
    persistence = close.pct_change(fill_method=None).rolling(20).apply(acf, raw=True)
    return pd.DataFrame({'range_position': position, 'acf1': persistence, 'close': close,
        'momentum20': close/close.shift(20)-1}, index=bars.index)

    recovery = (before_flat & frame.regime.eq('bear') & frame.last_exit_reason.eq('time')
                & frame.last_exit_route.eq('bear') & category.eq('BELOW') & body_up
                & ~acf_pass & range_pass & momentum_pass)
    eligible = range_pass & momentum_pass & (acf_pass | recovery.to_numpy())
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(acf_pass, frame.entry_acf_pass.to_numpy())

    assert not frame.entry_direction_gate_applies.any(), 'Recovery has no direction veto'
    assert not frame.signal_reason.eq('entry_direction_rejected').any()
    return {'acf_recovery_opportunities': int(recovery.sum()),
            'original_eligible_flat_opportunities': int((before_flat & range_pass & momentum_pass & acf_pass).sum()),
            'enhanced_eligible_flat_opportunities': int((before_flat & eligible).sum()),

def paired(first,second,label):
    # Difference is full policy outcome, not a sum of rejected predecessor trades.
    result={'comparison':label,'first':first['background']+'/'+first['mode'],
        'second':second['background']+'/'+second['mode'],
        'cagr_difference':second['net_cagr']-first['net_cagr'],
        'drawdown_difference':second['drawdown']-first['drawdown'],
        'closed_trade_difference':second['closed_trades']-first['closed_trades'],
        'annual_differences':{}}
    a={str(x['year']):x for x in first['paths']['annual_account']}
    b={str(x['year']):x for x in second['paths']['annual_account']}
    for year in a:
        result['annual_differences'][year]={'net_return':b[year]['account_return']-a[year]['account_return'],
            'price_contribution':b[year]['price_contribution']-a[year]['price_contribution'],
            'fee_contribution':b[year]['fee_contribution']-a[year]['fee_contribution']}
    def key(cycle):
        return (cycle['entry_fill_time'],cycle.get('exit_fill_time'),cycle['entry_route'])
    old={key(c):c for c in first['paths']['cycles']}
    new={key(c):c for c in second['paths']['cycles']}
    removed=[c for k,c in old.items() if k not in new]
    added=[c for k,c in new.items() if k not in old]
    result['cycle_changes']={'same_entry_exit_route':len(set(old)&set(new)),
        'removed_or_retimed':removed,'added_or_retimed':added,
        'warning':'different paths inherit different cash; old-cycle pnl is descriptive, not additive policy contribution'}
    return result

def _exit_category(close, anchor):
    """Strict price comparison at the final bear TIME signal; not trade PnL."""
    assert np.isfinite(close) and np.isfinite(anchor) and close > 0 and anchor > 0
    return 'BELOW' if close < anchor else 'ABOVE' if close > anchor else 'EQUAL'


def _reconstruct(bars, dates, p):
    """Recompute formulas and state without importing any strategy functions."""
    _validate_parameters(p)
    assert bars.index.is_unique and bars.index.is_monotonic_increasing
    assert dates.is_unique and dates.is_monotonic_increasing and dates.isin(bars.index).all()
    mechanism = p['mechanism']
    assert mechanism in MECHANISMS
    assert p['context'] == {'entry_gate': 'all', 'volume_basis': 'ADJUSTED',
                            'weighting': 'EQUAL_BLOCKS'}
    c = p['confirmation']
    assert c['enabled'] is True and c['profile'] == 'all'
    assert c['scope'] == 'both' and c['orientation'] == 1
    assert all(p[route]['cooldown'] == 0 for route in ('bull', 'bear'))
    assert type(c['lookback']) is int and 40 <= c['lookback'] <= 120
    assert np.isfinite(c['threshold'])
    close, opening, amount, volume = (bars[name].astype(float)
                                      for name in ('Close', 'Open', 'Amount', 'Volume'))
    for name in ('Close', 'Open', 'High', 'Low', 'Amount', 'Volume'):
        assert np.isfinite(bars[name]).all() and (bars[name] > 0).all(), name

    def covariance(items):
        centered = items - items.mean()
        variance = np.mean(centered ** 2)
        return np.nan if np.isclose(variance, 0) else float(
            np.dot(centered[1:], centered[:-1]) / 19 / variance)

    def rank(items):
        return float((np.count_nonzero(items < items[-1])
                      + .5 * np.count_nonzero(items == items[-1])) / len(items) - .5)

    full_acf = close.pct_change(fill_method=None).rolling(20).apply(covariance, raw=True)
    raw = pd.DataFrame({'acf': full_acf, 'turnover': amount / amount.rolling(20).mean(),
                        'volume': np.log(volume).diff().rolling(20).mean()}, index=bars.index)
    normalized = raw.apply(lambda series: series.rolling(c['lookback'],
        min_periods=c['lookback']).apply(rank, raw=True)).reindex(dates)
    assert np.isfinite(normalized.to_numpy()).all(), 'Incomplete causal score warmup'
    score = .5 * normalized.acf + .25 * normalized.turnover + .25 * normalized.volume
    raw_acf = full_acf.reindex(dates)
    positions = {route: ((close - bars.Low.rolling(p[route]['range_window']).min()) /
        (bars.High.rolling(p[route]['range_window']).max()
         - bars.Low.rolling(p[route]['range_window']).min())).reindex(dates)
        for route in ('bull', 'bear')}
    momentum20 = (close / close.shift(20) - 1).reindex(dates)
    full_momentum = close / close.shift(p['regime_window']) - 1
    momentum = full_momentum.reindex(dates)
    signal_close, signal_open, previous_close = close.reindex(dates), opening.reindex(dates), close.shift(1).reindex(dates)
    for series in (raw_acf, *positions.values(), momentum20, momentum,
                   signal_close, signal_open, previous_close):
        assert np.isfinite(series).all(), 'Incomplete causal input history'
    regimes = np.where(momentum >= p['regime_threshold'], 'bull', 'bear')
    direction = ((signal_close > signal_open) & (signal_close > previous_close)).to_numpy()
    expected = pd.DataFrame({'acf1': raw_acf, 'close': signal_close, 'momentum20': momentum20,
        'regime_momentum': momentum, 'regime': regimes,
        'bull_range_position': positions['bull'], 'bear_range_position': positions['bear'],
        'confirmation_score': score, 'confirmation_acf': normalized.acf,
        'confirmation_turnover': normalized.turnover, 'confirmation_volume': normalized.volume,
        'bear_acf_raw': raw_acf,
        'entry_signal_close': signal_close, 'entry_signal_open': signal_open,
        'previous_signal_close': previous_close, 'entry_direction_up': direction}, index=dates)
    return _state_path(expected, p)


def _state_path(features, p):
    """Independent state recurrence; features are causal and do not seed state."""
    expected = features.copy()
    assert np.isfinite(expected.acf1.to_numpy()).all(), 'Required original raw ACF must be finite even for recovery'
    c = p['confirmation']
    holding, active, age, anchor, peak, last, last_route, category = False, None, 0, 0., 0., None, None, None
    records = []
    for i in range(len(expected)):
        route = active if holding else str(expected.regime.iloc[i])
        rp, position = p[route], expected[f'{route}_range_position'].iloc[i]
        entry_acf = expected.acf1.iloc[i]
        acf_pass = rp['acf_min'] is None or entry_acf >= rp['acf_min']
        range_pass = bool(position <= rp['entry'])
        momentum_pass = bool(rp['momentum_min'] is None or expected.momentum20.iloc[i] >= rp['momentum_min'])
        recovery = bool(not holding and not acf_pass and range_pass and momentum_pass
                        and expected.regime.iloc[i] == 'bear' and last == 'time'
                        and last_route == 'bear' and category == 'BELOW'
                        and expected.entry_direction_up.iloc[i])
        eligible = bool(range_pass and momentum_pass and (acf_pass or recovery))
        opportunity = bool(not holding and eligible)
        passed = bool(expected.confirmation_score.iloc[i] >= c['threshold'])
        gate = False
        record = {'holding_before': holding, 'route_before': active,
            'age_before': age if holding else 0, 'active_route': route, 'eligible': eligible,
            'range_position': float(position), 'entry_acf_value': float(entry_acf),
            'entry_acf_pass': bool(acf_pass), 'entry_acf_recovery_applies': recovery,
            'entry_eligible': eligible, 'confirmation_opportunity': opportunity,
            'confirmation_pass': passed, 'confirmation_exit_context': last or 'initial',
            'entry_direction_gate_applies': gate, 'last_exit_reason': last, 'last_exit_route': last_route,
            'last_exit_category': category}
        reason = 'flat'
        if holding:
            age += 1
            peak = max(peak, expected.close.iloc[i])
            loss = rp['stop_loss'] is not None and expected.close.iloc[i] / anchor - 1 <= -rp['stop_loss']
            trail = rp['trailing_stop'] is not None and expected.close.iloc[i] / peak - 1 <= -rp['trailing_stop']
            reason = ('loss' if loss else 'trailing' if trail else 'range' if position >= rp['exit']
                else 'time' if age >= rp['max_hold'] else 'regime'
                if p['exit_on_regime_change'] and expected.regime.iloc[i] != active else 'hold')
            if reason != 'hold':
                category = (_exit_category(expected.close.iloc[i], anchor)
                            if reason == 'time' and active == 'bear' else None)
                holding, active, last, last_route = False, None, reason, active
        elif eligible:
            reason = 'entry' if passed else 'confirmation_rejected'
            if reason == 'entry':
                holding, active, age = True, str(expected.regime.iloc[i]), 0
                anchor = peak = expected.close.iloc[i]
                last = last_route = category = None
        record.update(signal_reason=reason, target_position=float(holding))
        records.append(record)
    states = pd.DataFrame(records, index=expected.index)
    for name in ('route_before', 'last_exit_reason', 'last_exit_route', 'last_exit_category'):
        states[name] = pd.Series([record[name] for record in records], index=expected.index, dtype=object)
    for name in states:
        expected[name] = states[name]
    return expected


def _validate_parameters(p):
    """Respect original units/domains without casting any numeric parameter."""

                      'exit_on_regime_change', 'confirmation', 'context', 'mechanism'}
    assert p['mechanism'] in MECHANISMS
    assert type(p['regime_window']) is int and 5 <= p['regime_window'] <= 60
    assert type(p['regime_threshold']) is float and -.2 <= p['regime_threshold'] <= .2
    assert type(p['exit_on_regime_change']) is bool
    c = p['confirmation']
    assert set(c) == {'enabled', 'profile', 'scope', 'orientation', 'lookback', 'threshold'}
    assert type(c['lookback']) is int and 40 <= c['lookback'] <= 120
    assert type(c['threshold']) is float and -.5 <= c['threshold'] <= .5
    assert c['enabled'] is True and c['profile'] == 'all' and c['scope'] == 'both'
    assert type(c['orientation']) is int and c['orientation'] == 1
    assert p['context'] == {'entry_gate': 'all', 'volume_basis': 'ADJUSTED', 'weighting': 'EQUAL_BLOCKS'}
    for route in ('bull', 'bear'):
        r = p[route]
        assert set(r) == {'range_window', 'entry', 'exit', 'max_hold', 'acf_min',
                          'stop_loss', 'trailing_stop', 'cooldown', 'momentum_min', 'limit_premium'}
        assert type(r['range_window']) is int and 21 <= r['range_window'] <= 360
        assert 0 <= r['entry'] < r['exit'] <= 1
        assert type(r['max_hold']) is int and 1 <= r['max_hold'] <= 60
        assert type(r['cooldown']) is int and r['cooldown'] == 0
        for key in ('stop_loss', 'trailing_stop'):
            assert r[key] is None or 0 < r[key] < .5
        for key in ('acf_min', 'momentum_min'):
            assert r[key] is None or np.isfinite(r[key])
        assert 0 <= r['limit_premium'] < .09
    assert p['bull']['limit_premium'] == p['bear']['limit_premium']



def _audit_dates(ctx, bound, binding, frame, dates, bars):
    """Use the bound calendar/execute dates, never a T+1 signal price."""
    dates = dates.as_unit('ns')
    plan = binding.plan
    request = plan.requests[plan.calendar_name]
    calendar = ctx.data.fetch(request, prepared=binding.prepared)
    assert calendar.ready and not SOURCE_CALLS, 'Existing prepared calendar required; no fallback'
    assert calendar.identity.content_sha256 == plan.calendar_sha256, 'Bound calendar identity drift'
    assert canonical_frame_sha256(calendar.dataframe) == calendar.identity.content_sha256, 'Prepared calendar bytes drift'
    assert calendar.identity.dataset == str(request.dataset) and calendar.identity.symbol == request.symbol
    data = calendar.dataframe
    calendar_dates = pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(data.Date)).normalize().as_unit('ns')
    assert calendar_dates.is_unique and calendar_dates.is_monotonic_increasing
    pd.testing.assert_index_equal(calendar_dates, pd.date_range(request.start, request.end).as_unit('ns'), check_names=False)
    assert data.IsOpen.isin((0, 1)).all(), 'Invalid public calendar open flag'
    opened = calendar_dates[data.IsOpen.to_numpy() == 1]
    pd.testing.assert_index_equal(opened, pd.DatetimeIndex(plan.calendar_dates).as_unit('ns'), check_names=False)
    previous = pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(data.loc[data.IsOpen.eq(1), 'PreviousTradingDate'])).normalize().as_unit('ns')
    pd.testing.assert_index_equal(previous[1:], opened[:-1], check_names=False)
    assert np.all(previous < opened), 'Public previous-session relation must be strict'
    window = plan.tradable_window
    expected_valid = opened[(opened >= pd.Timestamp(window.start)) & (opened <= pd.Timestamp(window.end))]
    locations = opened.get_indexer(expected_valid)
    assert len(expected_valid) and np.all(locations > 0), 'Complete pre-window signal calendar required'
    expected_signals = opened[locations - 1]
    pd.testing.assert_index_equal(dates, expected_signals, check_names=False)
    actual_valid = pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(frame.valid_session)).normalize().as_unit('ns')
    pd.testing.assert_index_equal(actual_valid, expected_valid, check_names=False)
    assert dict(plan.signal_dates) == {valid.date(): signal.date()
        for valid, signal in zip(expected_valid, expected_signals, strict=True)}, 'Entire public signal mapping drift'
    # Execution preparation covers first T through final T+1, while the signal
    # OHLC request correctly stops at final T. Only dates below are inspected.
    execution_dates = pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(bound.execution_data.execution_daily.dt)).normalize().as_unit('ns')
    assert execution_dates.is_unique and execution_dates.is_monotonic_increasing
    execution_expected = expected_signals.union(expected_valid).sort_values()
    pd.testing.assert_index_equal(execution_dates, execution_expected, check_names=False)
    pd.testing.assert_index_equal(pd.DatetimeIndex(bound.execution_data.evaluation_sessions).normalize().as_unit('ns'),
                                  expected_valid, check_names=False)
    pd.testing.assert_index_equal(bars.index.as_unit('ns').intersection(execution_dates), expected_signals, check_names=False)
    signal_locations = execution_dates.get_indexer(dates)
    assert np.all(signal_locations >= 0) and np.all(signal_locations + 1 < len(execution_dates))
    pd.testing.assert_index_equal(execution_dates[signal_locations + 1], actual_valid, check_names=False)
    return {'source': 'Existing prepared bound calendar and execution_daily date sequence',
            'calendar_sha256': plan.calendar_sha256, 'exact_signal_execute_pairs': len(dates),
            'first_signal': dates[0].date().isoformat(), 'last_signal': dates[-1].date().isoformat(),
            'first_valid_session': actual_valid[0].date().isoformat(),
            'last_valid_session': actual_valid[-1].date().isoformat(),
            'final_signal_ohlc_date': bars.index[-1].date().isoformat(),
            'future_signal_prices_used': False, 'final_pair_retained': True}



def _assert_exit_metadata(actual, expected, name):
    """Compare only nullable signal metadata; all financial fields remain exact."""
    categories = {'last_exit_reason': {'time', 'regime', 'range', 'loss', 'trailing'},
                  'last_exit_route': {'bull', 'bear'},
                  'last_exit_category': {'BELOW', 'EQUAL', 'ABOVE'}}
    assert name in categories
    actual, expected = np.asarray(actual, dtype=object), np.asarray(expected, dtype=object)
    assert actual.shape == expected.shape
    missing = np.array([value is None for value in expected])
    for i, (value, wanted) in enumerate(zip(actual, expected, strict=True)):

    assert reference in analysis["points"], (label, reference)

    new = sorted(analysis["points"][label], key=lambda row: row["point_index"])

        return audit_dual_recovery(ctx, bound, frame, parameters)
    if key == "B0-COUPLED":

    return None


def economic(bound, result):
    run = result.runs[0]
    own, benchmark = run.execution.account_daily, run.buyhold.account_daily
    years, byears = annual(own), annual(benchmark)
    cagr = float((own.equity.iloc[-1] / 1_000_000) ** (252 / len(own)) - 1)
    bcagr = float((benchmark.equity.iloc[-1] / 1_000_000) ** (252 / len(benchmark)) - 1)
    wealth = np.r_[1_000_000, own.equity.to_numpy()]
    drawdown = float(np.max(1 - wealth / np.maximum.accumulate(wealth)))
    closed = int(run.execution.trades.status.eq("CLOSED").sum())
    negative = [year for year in byears if byears[year]["return"] < 0]
    gates = {
        "return": cagr >= 1.5 * bcagr if bcagr > 0 else cagr > 0,
        "annual_drawdown": all(years[y]["drawdown"] < byears[y]["drawdown"] for y in years),
        "frequency": closed * 60 / len(own) >= 4,
        "negative_buyhold_year_profit": all(years[y]["return"] > 0 for y in negative),
    }
    audit = verify_account(bound, result)
    return {
        "net_cagr": cagr,
        "drawdown": drawdown,
        "closed_trades": closed,
        "frequency60": closed * 60 / len(own),
        "annual": years,
        "benchmark_annual": byears,
        "gates": gates,
        "qualified": all(gates.values()),
        "account_audit": audit,
    }

        path = ROOT / ".tmp" / ("s013-mechanism-" + origin[:5]) / (label + ".pkl.gz")

        previous = read(ROOT / "research/S013/experiments" / origin / "protocols/plan.json")
        parent = next(
            row
            for row in previous.get("controls", []) + previous["configurations"]

        )
        binding = bound.lineage.parameter_binding
        assert binding.point == old_design.bind_point(row["point_index"])
        assert binding.plan.to_dict() == record["plan_reference"]
        assert file_hash(binding.plan.resolve(ROOT)) == binding.plan.sha256
        assert read(binding.plan.resolve(ROOT)) == transport["plan"].to_dict()
        identity = ctx.runtime.identify(bound.strategy, dependencies=bound.dependencies)
        assert identity.content_sha256 == row["content_sha256"]
        assert identity.source_sha256 == config["payload"]["runtime"]["source_sha256"]
        assert canonical_sha256(bound.runtime_binding) == result.runtime_binding_hash
        assert result.strategy_identity == bound.strategy.runtime_identity_sha256
        cache_write(point_cache(key, row["label"]), (bound, result))
        rows.append(
            {
                **deepcopy(row),
                "control_key": key,
                "reused": True,
                "reused_from": origin,
                "actual_this_experiment": False,
            }
        )
    return (
        {
            **deepcopy(record),
            "control_key": key,
            "native_label": native_label,
            "reused": True,
            "reused_from": origin,
            "center_qualified": True,
            "role": "exact native "
            + key
            + " full32 control; original IDs/labels/plans/lineage preserved",
        },
        {**transport, "control_key": key},
        rows,
    )

def precheck():
    source_check()
    manifest = read(MANIFEST)
    if manifest["status"] == "NOT_APPLICABLE":
        return
    assert not (RUNS / "parameter_precheck.json").exists()
    rows, actual = [], 0
    for record, transport in zip(
        manifest["centers"], cache_read(TRANSPORT / "prepared.pkl.gz"), strict=True
    ):
        key = record["control_key"]
        assert key == transport["control_key"]
        if record["reused"]:
            proof = read(
                ROOT
                / "research/S013/assets/runs"
                / record["reused_from"]
                / "parameter_precheck.json"
            )
            ref = EvidenceRef.from_dict(proof["reference"])
            assert proof["status"] == "PASS" and file_hash(ref.resolve(ROOT)) == ref.sha256
            assert read(ref.resolve(ROOT)) == {
                name: value for name, value in proof.items() if name != "reference"
            }
            native = next(row for row in proof["rows"] if row["center"] == record["native_label"])
            rows.append(
                {
                    **deepcopy(native),
                    "control_key": key,
                    "reused": True,
                    "source_reference": ref.to_dict(),
                }
            )
            continue
        bound = transport["children"][0]
        serial = context(1).evaluation.evaluate(bound)
        cache_write(point_cache(key, "N0-P00"), (bound, serial))
        spawned = context(2).evaluation.evaluate_many((bound,))[0]
        assert spawned.status.value == "SUCCEEDED", spawned.error
        cache_write(TRANSPORT / key / "N0-P00-spawn.pkl.gz", (bound, spawned.result))
        equal_results(serial, spawned.result)
        actual += 2
        rows.append(
            {
                "center": "N0",
                "control_key": key,
                "point": 0,
                "reused": False,
                "result_hash": serial.result_hash,
                "serial_spawn": "EXACT_EQUAL signals and5strategy/benchmarkledgers",
            }
        )
    assert actual == 2 and not SOURCE_CALLS
    proof = {"status": "PASS", "rows": rows, "actual_evaluations": actual, "provider_calls": []}
    proof["reference"] = publish_material(context(1), "parameter-precheck", proof).to_dict()
    write(RUNS / "parameter_precheck.json", proof)


def trial_index(global_index, reused_count):
    assert type(global_index) is int and type(reused_count) is int and reused_count == 64
    assert reused_count <= global_index < reused_count + 32
    return global_index - reused_count


def run():
    source_check()
    manifest = read(MANIFEST)
    if manifest["status"] == "NOT_APPLICABLE":
        return
    assert read(RUNS / "parameter_precheck.json")["status"] == "PASS"
    ctx = context(8)
    prepared = cache_read(TRANSPORT / "prepared.pkl.gz")
    record = next(row for row in manifest["centers"] if row["control_key"] == "N0")
    transport = next(row for row in prepared if row["control_key"] == "N0")
    items = list(zip(record["children"], transport["children"], strict=True))
    assert len(items) == 32
    reused_count = len(manifest["reused_rows"])
    assert reused_count == 64
    study_path = TRANSPORT / "study.pkl.gz"
    if study_path.exists():
        study, state = cache_read(study_path), read(CHECKPOINT)
        assert state["status"] != "FAILED" and state["inflight"] is None
        assert (
            len(state["rows"]) >= reused_count
            and state["rows"][:reused_count] == manifest["reused_rows"]
        )
    else:
        optuna.logging.set_verbosity(optuna.logging.WARNING)
        study = optuna.create_study(
            direction="maximize",
            sampler=optuna.samplers.RandomSampler(seed=13),
            study_name="S013-EX056-raw-bear-time-below-body-close-acf-recovery-fixed-parameter-diagnostic",
        )
        for i in range(32):
            study.enqueue_trial({"point": i})
        for i in range(32):
            trial = study.ask()
            assert trial.suggest_int("point", 0, 31) == i
        state = {
            "status": "PARTIAL",
            "rows": deepcopy(manifest["reused_rows"]),
            "inflight": None,
            "actual_run_evaluations": 0,
            "planned_business_accounts": 96,
            "provider_calls": [],
        }
        cache_write(study_path, study)
        write(CHECKPOINT, state)
    started = time.perf_counter()
    for offset in range(len(state["rows"]) - reused_count, len(items), 8):
        batch = items[offset : offset + 8]
        pending = [
            (cfg, bound) for cfg, bound in batch if not point_cache("N0", cfg["label"]).exists()
        ]
        state["inflight"] = [cfg["label"] for cfg, _ in pending]
        state["actual_run_evaluations"] += len(pending)
        write(CHECKPOINT, state)
        outcomes = (
            ctx.evaluation.evaluate_many(tuple(bound for _, bound in pending)) if pending else ()
        )
        failures = []
        for (cfg, bound), outcome in zip(pending, outcomes, strict=True):
            if outcome.status.value == "SUCCEEDED":
                cache_write(point_cache("N0", cfg["label"]), (bound, outcome.result))
            else:
                failures.append(
                    {
                        "label": cfg["label"],
                        "status": outcome.status.value,
                        "error": {"code": outcome.error.code, "message": outcome.error.message},
                    }
                )
        if failures:
            state.update(status="FAILED", failures=failures, inflight=None)
            write(CHECKPOINT, state)
            raise RuntimeError("Parameter failures retained; no automatic retry/replacement")
        requests, loaded = [], []
        for cfg, expected in batch:
            bound, result = cache_read(point_cache("N0", cfg["label"]))
            assert bound.lineage == expected.lineage
            assert result.runs[0].identity.content_sha256 == cfg["content_sha256"]
            loaded.append((cfg, bound, result))
            requests.append(
                EvaluationEvidenceWrite(
                    EXPERIMENT, "parameter-account-" + cfg["label"].lower(), bound, result
                )
            )
        published = publish_evidence_many(ctx, tuple(requests))
        assert all(outcome.status.value == "PUBLISHED" for outcome in published)
        for index, ((cfg, bound, result), outcome) in enumerate(
            zip(loaded, published, strict=True), start=offset
        ):
            global_index = reused_count + index
            study.tell(
                trial_index(global_index, reused_count), float(result.runs[0].observation.net_cagr)
            )
            state["rows"].append(
                {
                    "label": cfg["label"],
                    "center": "N0",
                    "control_key": "N0",
                    "point_index": cfg["point_index"],
                    "candidate_id": cfg["candidate_id"],
                    "content_sha256": cfg["content_sha256"],
                    "status": "SUCCEEDED",
                    "reference": outcome.reference.to_dict(),
                    "request_hash": result.request_hash,
                    "result_hash": result.result_hash,
                    "reused": False,
                }
            )
        assert len(manifest["reused_rows"]) == reused_count
        state.update(
            status="COMPLETE" if len(state["rows"]) == 96 else "PARTIAL",
            inflight=None,
            elapsed_seconds=time.perf_counter() - started,
            provider_calls=SOURCE_CALLS,
        )
        cache_write(study_path, study)
        write(CHECKPOINT, state)
        print({"parameter_rows": len(state["rows"]), "status": state["status"]}, flush=True)
    assert (
        state["status"] == "COMPLETE" and state["actual_run_evaluations"] == 31 and not SOURCE_CALLS
    )
    state.update(
        new_parameter_business_accounts=32,
        reused_parameter_accounts=64,
        actual_parameter_evaluations=33,
    )
    state["reference"] = publish_material(ctx, "parameter-complete-matrix", state).to_dict()
    write(CHECKPOINT, state)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("phase", choices=("declare", "precheck", "run"))
    parser.add_argument("--first-candidate", type=int, default=RESERVED_FIRST)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    {"declare": lambda: declare(args.first_candidate), "precheck": precheck, "run": run}[
        args.phase
    ]()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def standard(value):
    """No general missing/NaN cleanup: nullable metadata is explicitly None."""
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {str(k): standard(v) for k, v in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
        return [standard(v) for v in value]
    if isinstance(value, (pd.Timestamp, np.datetime64)):
        assert not pd.isna(value)
        return pd.Timestamp(value).isoformat()
    if isinstance(value, np.generic):
        return standard(value.item())
    if isinstance(value, float):
        assert np.isfinite(value), "Nonfinite number cannot be retained"
    if value is pd.NA or value is pd.NaT:
        raise AssertionError("Missing value must be explicit None")
    return value

def load(name, path):

    sys.modules[name] = module
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


def pure_induction(frame, p):
    """Own common-state recurrence, not a financial or order replay.

    The old BODY recovery can differ from dual recovery only at original ACF
    failure with range/momentum/context/body eligibility. Require Close-up at
    EVERY such day, before score, and reconstruct both equal next states.
    """
    assert p["mechanism"] == OLD_MECHANISM
    assert p["context"] == {
        "entry_gate": "all",
        "volume_basis": "ADJUSTED",
        "weighting": "EQUAL_BLOCKS",
    }
    c = p["confirmation"]
    assert c["enabled"] and c["scope"] == "both"
    assert all(p[r]["cooldown"] == 0 for r in ("bull", "bear"))
    assert frame.index.is_unique and frame.index.is_monotonic_increasing and len(frame)
    holding, active, age, anchor, peak, last, last_route, category = (
        False,
        None,
        0,
        None,
        None,
        None,
        None,
        None,
    )
    records, recovery = [], []
    for i, row in enumerate(frame.itertuples()):
        for field in (
            "close",
            "entry_signal_close",
            "entry_signal_open",
            "previous_signal_close",
            "acf1",
            "momentum20",
            "confirmation_score",
            "bull_range_position",
            "bear_range_position",
        ):
            assert np.isfinite(getattr(row, field)), field
        assert (
            row.close == row.entry_signal_close > 0
            and row.entry_signal_open > 0
            and row.previous_signal_close > 0
        )
        assert row.regime in ("bull", "bear")
        assert (row.last_exit_reason, row.last_exit_route, row.last_exit_category) == (
            last,
            last_route,
            category,
        )
        route = active if holding else row.regime
        rp = p[route]
        position = getattr(row, route + "_range_position")
        before = (
            holding,
            active,
            age if holding else 0,
            anchor if holding else None,
            peak if holding else None,
            last,
            last_route,
            category,
        )
        acf_pass = rp["acf_min"] is None or row.acf1 >= rp["acf_min"]
        range_pass = position <= rp["entry"]
        momentum_pass = rp["momentum_min"] is None or row.momentum20 >= rp["momentum_min"]
        body = row.entry_signal_close > row.entry_signal_open
        close_up = row.entry_signal_close > row.previous_signal_close
        context = (
            not holding
            and row.regime == "bear"
            and last == "time"
            and last_route == "bear"
            and category == "BELOW"
        )
        old_recovery = bool(range_pass and momentum_pass and not acf_pass and context and body)
        new_recovery = bool(old_recovery and close_up)
        assert not old_recovery or close_up, (
            "Old recovery day lacks strict Close-up: equivalence theorem inapplicable"
        )
        old_eligible = bool(range_pass and momentum_pass and (acf_pass or context and body))
        new_eligible = bool(
            range_pass and momentum_pass and (acf_pass or context and body and close_up)
        )
        assert old_eligible == new_eligible and old_recovery == new_recovery
        score_pass = row.confirmation_score >= c["threshold"]
        opportunity = not holding and old_eligible
        assert bool(row.entry_acf_pass) == bool(acf_pass)
        assert row.entry_acf_value == row.acf1
        assert bool(row.entry_acf_recovery_applies) == old_recovery
        assert bool(row.entry_eligible) == old_eligible
        assert bool(row.confirmation_opportunity) == opportunity
        assert bool(row.confirmation_pass) == score_pass
        assert bool(row.entry_direction_up) == body
        assert not row.entry_direction_gate_applies
        assert row.confirmation_exit_context == (last or "initial")
        reason = "flat"
        if holding:
            age += 1
            peak = max(peak, row.close)
            loss = rp["stop_loss"] is not None and row.close / anchor - 1 <= -rp["stop_loss"]
            trail = rp["trailing_stop"] is not None and row.close / peak - 1 <= -rp["trailing_stop"]
            reason = (
                "loss"
                if loss
                else "trailing"
                if trail
                else "range"
                if position >= rp["exit"]
                else "time"
                if age >= rp["max_hold"]
                else "regime"
                if p["exit_on_regime_change"] and row.regime != active
                else "hold"
            )
            if reason != "hold":
                category = (
                    ("BELOW" if row.close < anchor else "ABOVE" if row.close > anchor else "EQUAL")
                    if reason == "time" and active == "bear"
                    else None
                )
                holding, last, last_route, active = False, reason, active, None
        elif old_eligible:
            reason = "entry" if score_pass else "confirmation_rejected"
            if score_pass:
                holding, active, age, anchor, peak = True, row.regime, 0, row.close, row.close
                last = last_route = category = None
        assert reason == row.signal_reason and float(holding) == row.target_position
        after = (
            holding,
            active,
            age if holding else 0,
            anchor if holding else None,
            peak if holding else None,
            last,
            last_route,
            category,
        )
        record = {
            "index": i,
            "signal_date": frame.index[i],
            "raw_route": row.regime,
            "before": before,
            "after": after,
            "old_eligible": old_eligible,
            "new_eligible": new_eligible,
            "old_recovery": old_recovery,
            "new_recovery": new_recovery,
            "score_pass": bool(score_pass),
            "body_up": bool(body),
            "close_up": bool(close_up),
            "signal_reason": reason,
            "target": float(holding),
            "entry_signal_close": row.entry_signal_close,
            "entry_signal_open": row.entry_signal_open,
            "previous_signal_close": row.previous_signal_close,
        }
        records.append(record)
        if old_recovery:
            recovery.append(record)
    groups = []
    years = sorted(set(frame.index.year))
    for year in ("ALL", *map(str, years)):
        for route in ("bull", "bear"):
            rows = [
                r
                for r in records
                if (year == "ALL" or str(r["signal_date"].year) == year) and r["raw_route"] == route
            ]
            rec = [r for r in rows if r["old_recovery"]]
            groups.append(
                {
                    "signal_year": year,
                    "raw_route": route,
                    "signal_days": len(rows),
                    "recovery_opportunities": len(rec),
                    "recovery_entries": sum(r["signal_reason"] == "entry" for r in rec),
                    "recovery_score_rejections": sum(
                        r["signal_reason"] == "confirmation_rejected" for r in rec
                    ),
                }
            )
    assert sum(r["signal_days"] for r in groups if r["signal_year"] == "ALL") == len(frame)
    assert sum(r["signal_days"] for r in groups if r["signal_year"] != "ALL") == len(frame)
    return {
        "status": "PASS",
        "all_days": records,
        "recovery_events": recovery,
        "groups": groups,
        "all_recovery_close_up": True,
        "same_state_induction_days": len(records),
        "terminal_common_state": records[-1]["after"],
    }


def compare_histories(old, new):
    pd.testing.assert_index_equal(old.index, new.index, exact=True)
    assert list(old.columns) == list(new.columns), (
        "Only declared diagnostic change allowed, no missing fields"
    )
    compared = [c for c in old if c != "entry_direction_up"]
    pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(old[compared], new[compared], check_exact=True)
    assert np.array_equal(old.entry_direction_up, old.entry_signal_close.gt(old.entry_signal_open))
    assert np.array_equal(
        new.entry_direction_up,
        new.entry_signal_close.gt(new.entry_signal_open)
        & new.entry_signal_close.gt(new.previous_signal_close),
    )
    assert not (
        old.entry_acf_recovery_applies & old.entry_direction_up.ne(new.entry_direction_up)
    ).any()
    return {
        "status": "EXACT_SIGNAL_EQUIVALENCE",
        "signal_days": len(old),
        "exact_fields": compared,
        "allowed_diagnostic_fields": ["entry_direction_up"],
        "diagnostic_different_days": int(old.entry_direction_up.ne(new.entry_direction_up).sum()),
        "target_different_days": 0,
        "reason_different_days": 0,
    }

    """Public exact method retention is checked before loading old cache or data."""
    from czsc_trader.research_tools.evidence import EvidenceRef

    method = read_json(path)
    authenticate_hashes(method)
    ref = EvidenceRef.from_dict(read_json(ROOT / method["public_method_reference_path"]))
    assert ref.experiment.strategy_id == "S013" and ref.experiment.experiment_id == "EX056_20261011"
    assert digest(ref.resolve(ROOT)) == ref.sha256
    assert read_json(ref.resolve(ROOT)) == method
    return method, ref
